* Develop prescriptive optimization engines using Reinforcement Learning (RL), Contextual Bandits, or mathematical optimization to power real-time "Next Best Action" (NBA) and dynamic pricing recommendations.
* Apply causal inference and uplift modeling techniques to measure and optimize the true incremental impact of AI-driven interventions.
* Production Engineering & MLOps
* Collaborate with MLOps and Data Engineering teams to deploy machine learning and agentic models into highly scalable, low-latency production environments.
* Write production-grade, optimized code (Python) and build robust API endpoints for AI service integration.
* Design and maintain telemetry for monitoring model drift, agent hallucination rates, and overall system performance.
* Technical Leadership & Collaboration
* Lead the end-to-end technical execution of complex AI projects, from ideation and prototyping to production deployment.
* Mentor Engineer I and II team members, conduct rigorous code/model reviews, and foster a culture of continuous learning.
* Partner closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Business Stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.

* Technical Skills:Advanced proficiency in Python and standard ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, XGBoost/LightGBM).Hands-on experience building and deploying LLMs and Agentic AI (LangChain, OpenAI APIs, open-source models like Llama 3/Mistral, RAG architectures).Strong foundation in Predictive and Prescriptive ML methodologies (time-series, reinforcement learning, optimization algorithms).Solid SQL skills and experience with big data processing (Spark, Databricks, Snowflake).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Causal Machine Learning (DoWhy, EconML).
* Active contributor to open-source AI projects or a portfolio demonstrating complex agentic workflow development.

Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
**About the job :**

Complyance is a fast-growing e-invoicing and tax compliance SaaS company. Through a single API, we help businesses meet e-invoicing mandates across markets, including the UAE and Saudi Arabia’s ZATCA requirements, without rebuilding their finance systems every time a regulation changes.

We have built a strong base in MENA and India, our platform is live across 10+ jurisdictions, and we are now expanding into Europe and the US.

We are building a developer-first e-invoicing platform for businesses, enterprises and ecosystem partners: secure, dependable APIs and integrations, with an exceptional developer and customer experience.

**Life at Complyance :**

We are a lean, high-ownership team that cares about doing the basics exceptionally well. Our work is visible, our decisions matter, and we are looking for people who want to shape how a company grows, not just keep it running.

**The mission :**

This is not a role for managing from the sidelines. You will be the hands-on engineering leader who shapes our technology platform, builds a high-performing team and sets the engineering practices needed to scale a regulated, transaction-focused SaaS business.

You will report to the CTO and work closely with the founders and product leadership, with direct influence over product architecture, engineering culture and team formation. You will stay technically engaged: in architecture reviews, design discussions and the critical technical decisions.

**Where you’ll leave your mark :**

**•**
**Set the engineering direction:**

 Own engineering strategy and execution for our e-invoicing platform, including the technical roadmap, architecture decisions and the management of technical debt.

**•**
**Build APIs people trust:**

 Own the architecture and delivery of secure, scalable APIs, SDKs, webhooks and enterprise integrations, and the developer experience around them.

**•**
**Keep the platform reliable:**

 Own reliability, availability, observability, security and production operations.

**•**
**Grow the team:**

 Lead engineering hiring, mentoring, performance and team development.

**•**
**Raise the engineering bar:**

 Run the practices that keep quality high: design reviews, testing, releases, incident response and postmortems.

**•**
**Work across the business:**

 Collaborate with product, customer success, implementation, compliance and enterprise customers.

**The kind of leader we’re looking for :**

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

**•**

Have 8–12 years of software engineering experience, including experience leading engineering teams.

**•**

Have a strong background in backend engineering, distributed systems, cloud platforms and API design.

**•**

Are tech-savvy, with a strong command of advanced technologies and modern engineering tools.

**•**

Have built or operated high-volume, transaction-oriented SaaS platforms.

**•**

Can manage, coach and grow high-performing engineers.

**•**

Know production reliability, observability, incident management and secure software delivery.

**•**

Bring strong product thinking, execution discipline and customer orientation.

**•**

Are comfortable in a fast-moving startup with ambiguity and significant ownership.

**•**

Communicate clearly, in writing and in conversation.

And as a person, you:

**•**

Combine people leadership with strong technical judgement.

**•**

Operate with high ownership and low ego.

**•**

Make pragmatic decisions with limited time and resources.

**•**

Move comfortably between architecture, hiring, delivery, customers and production issues.

**•**

Build simple, reliable systems rather than introducing unnecessary complexity.

**•**

Care deeply about API quality, security, documentation and developer experience.

**Bonus points :**

**•**

Experience in payments, fintech, invoicing, tax technology, accounting, ERP or compliance platforms.

**•**

Experience with external APIs, SDKs, webhooks, authentication, rate limiting, versioning, retries and idempotency.

**•**

Experience with multi-tenant SaaS and enterprise integration architecture.

**•**

Experience handling sensitive financial or business information.

**•**

Experience with government, tax-authority, Peppol or other regulated-network integrations.

**•**

Experience at a FAANG company (Facebook/Meta, Amazon, Apple, Netflix or Google), Amazon/AWS, or another high-scale product engineering organisation. This is an added advantage, not a requirement.

**Why Complyance?**

**•**

Competitive base salary. The range will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

**•**

Comprehensive benefits, including health insurance for you and your family and paid time off.

**•**

The chance to build for a category that is being shaped by regulation right now, across some of the fastest-moving e-invoicing markets in the world.

**•**

A lean, collaborative team where your work is visible and your decisions matter.

**How to apply**

* Apply on LinkedIn, or share the profile of someone you think is a strong fit. Please include the candidate’s current location, notice period, present role and LinkedIn profile.

title: Senior Security Architect
description:
Expleo is a trusted partner for end-to-end, integrated engineering, quality services, and management consulting for digital transformation. We help businesses harness technological change to deliver innovation, improve resilience, and support the secure delivery of complex products, platforms, and systems.
  
  
As part of the Expleo UK Cybersecurity Practice, you will join a managed Cyber Operations service for a major UK energy network operator that forms part of the UK's Critical National Infrastructure (CNI). The service is governed by Expleo in the UK, with a 24/7 UK Security Operations Centre delivered by a specialist partner and an Expleo consultancy team in India providing design, engineering and assurance expertise across the client's security tooling estate.
  
  
As
**Senior Security Architect**
, you will be the senior technical adviser within the offshore consultancy team. Working under the technical direction of the UK Head of Service, who holds design authority, you will produce the security architecture, design and risk material that underpins the service, and provide technical leadership to the offshore engineers.
  
  
**This is a design, review and advisory role.**
You will work within Expleo's offshore consultancy team, outside the client's operational environment. You will not have access to the client's operational systems or data and will not make live changes. Operational changes are implemented by UK-based, security-cleared personnel; your work provides the designs, analysis, recommendations and assurance that those changes depend on. You will work from information released to the team through Expleo's controlled UK service boundary.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**

* Produce and maintain security architecture and design documentation (high-level and low-level designs) for the client's security tooling estate, for approval by the UK Head of Service.
* Carry out architecture and risk reviews of proposed high-risk changes (firewall, intrusion prevention, gateway, privileged access and application control) before they are presented to the client's Change Advisory Board.
* Define logging and audit requirements for in-scope security tools, including log sources, feed requirements for the client's retained SIEM, and a retention architecture aligned with client policy and regulatory obligations.
* Assess and recommend tooling and approaches for PKI and secrets management.
* Produce NIS Regulations and NCSC Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF) alignment assessments and contribute evidence to the client's regulatory reporting.
* Prepare inputs for the client's governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) reporting on the enterprise's security status.
* Develop risk treatment plans in line with client policy and industry best practice and maintain inputs to the security risk register.
* Prepare technical content and risk papers for the client's cyber security governance board, in support of the UK Head of Service and the Lead Information Risk Manager.
* Maintain the master set of security architecture diagrams and ensure that diagrams produced by the engineering team are consistent and up to date.
* Identify and assess continual improvement opportunities, including benefit-cost appraisal and sequencing into quick wins, foundational change and strategic uplift.
* Apply appropriate consideration of operational technology (OT) and IT/OT boundary risk in all architecture and design work.
* Provide technical leadership, peer review and mentoring to the Lead Security Engineer, Security Engineers and Vulnerability and Patch Manager.
* Support the growth of Expleo's Cybersecurity Practice through knowledge sharing, technical contribution and client-facing delivery excellence.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in computer science, cybersecurity, information systems or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* CISSP, CISSP-ISSAP or SABSA Chartered Foundation (at least one required).
* TOGAF, a cloud security certification (e.g. CCSP, AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty) or GICSP/ISA/IEC 62443 certification would be advantageous.

**Essential Skills**

* Enterprise security architecture across network, identity, endpoint, cloud and data security domains.
* Designing logging and SIEM integration architectures, including log source definition and retention requirements.
* Applying risk assessment methods such as ISO/IEC 27005 and NIST SP 800-30.
* Working knowledge of the NIS Regulations, NCSC CAF, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF and CIS Controls.
* Reviewing proposed changes for architectural and security risk, and producing clear, evidence-based recommendations.
* Excellent written communication for executive, governance and regulator-facing documentation.

Ability to lead and quality-assure the work of other engineers
  
  
**Desired Skills**

* Energy, utilities or other CNI sector experience.
* Knowledge of OT/ICS security concepts, the Purdue model and IEC 62443.
* Experience with GRC tooling (e.g. ServiceNow IRM, Archer).
* Experience with Ofgem or NIS-regulated cyber assurance activity.

**Experience**

* 12+ years in IT and cybersecurity, including 6+ years in security architecture for enterprise or CNI environments.
* Experience producing architecture, design and risk artefacts for regulated organisations.
* Experience supporting governance boards, risk registers and GRC reporting.
* Experience working with multi-supplier environments and managed security service providers.

**What Do I Need Before I Apply**

* Have the right to work in India.
* Be based in, or willing to relocate to, Chennai.
* Be willing to complete Expleo enhanced pre-employment background screening (equivalent in standard to the UK Baseline Personnel Security Standard) and any additional vetting the client requires.
* Be able to work hours that overlap with the UK business day, with occasional out-of-hours advisory support during major incidents.
* Have excellent written and spoken English, suitable for engagement with senior UK stakeholders.
* Be comfortable working within a strict security boundary, with no access to the client's operational systems or data.

**Benefits**

* Collaborative working environment: we stand shoulder to shoulder with our clients and our peers through good times and challenges.
* We empower all passionate, technology-loving professionals to expand their skills and take part in inspiring projects.
* Expleo Academy enables you to acquire and develop the right skills by delivering a suite of accredited training courses.
* Competitive local company benefits [India HR to confirm the benefits package].
* Always working as one team, our people are not afraid to think big and challenge the status quo.

“We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.”
  
  
If you are an experienced Security Architect with a strong background in enterprise and CNI security architecture, and you enjoy shaping how critical services are secured, we encourage you to apply today.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
About Moative

Moative is an AI diffusion company. We partner with midmarket companies in asset-heavy, regulated industries to co-build deeply industry-specific agentic and machine learning solutions, which then get diffused across the industry through revenue-share and equity-linked models.

**Our Past**

: We have built and sold two companies, one of which was an AI company. Our founders and leaders are Math PhDs, Ivy League University Alumni, Ex-Googlers, and successful entrepreneurs.

**Team**

: Our team of 20+ employees consists of data scientists, AI/ML Engineers, and mathematicians from top engineering and research institutes such as IITs, CERN, IISc, UZH. Our team includes academicians, IBM Research Fellows, and former founders. This role leads technology for our healthcare business, working alongside forward-deployed engineers, data scientists and revenue cycle operators to build an AI management services organization (AI MSO) for US healthcare practices.

Work you’ll do

We are building an AI management services organization (AI MSO) for US healthcare practices. We combine operational expertise, data infrastructure and AI to manage and improve revenue cycle and administrative workflows. We automate suitable tasks progressively, with clear controls and human accountability for exceptions and consequential decisions.

As CTO, you will own the technology strategy, platform architecture and engineering organization behind this business. You will work with our founders, practice owners and billing leaders to decide what to build, which workflows to prioritize and how to measure results. You will remain hands-on in architecture, prototypes, code reviews and difficult production problems.

You will build a reusable platform that connects practice systems, supports reliable automation and captures operational learning across engagements, while maintaining appropriate separation of each practice’s data. The work includes payer-portal agents, voice-based payer follow-up, claim-journey analysis, denial management and payment-posting workflows.

Technical leads will own day-to-day pod delivery within the direction you set. You will resolve major technical trade-offs, develop those leaders and remain accountable for platform quality, reliability and technical risk.

Responsibilities

* Own technology strategy, platform architecture and engineering standards for the healthcare AI MSO.
* Work with founders, practice owners and billing leaders to assess workflows, establish baselines and prioritize investments by business value, feasibility and dependencies.
* Lead product and platform decisions, balancing practice-specific requirements with capabilities that can be reused across customers and specialties.
* Design solutions across EHRs, practice-management systems, clearinghouses and payer portals, connecting data pipelines, AI agents and operator workflows.
* Define the practice data architecture, integrating claims, remittances, EOBs, denial codes and operational records into validated, traceable data with clear access controls and isolation between practices.
* Separate operational data that requires patient identifiers from de-identified analytical datasets, and define approved uses of each.
* Stay hands-on through architecture and code reviews, targeted prototypes and resolution of complex production issues.
* Make build-versus-buy, vendor and model decisions based on reliability, security, cost and business value.
* Establish technical controls for healthcare privacy, security and compliance, working with legal, compliance and client stakeholders on approved data flows, retention, vendor access and incident response.
* Set production evaluation and release criteria, including monitoring, human escalation, recovery procedures and ownership of failures.
* Own engineering and infrastructure budgets, platform operating costs and investment in reusable capabilities.
* Hire, develop and retain engineers, data scientists and technical leads, with clear accountability for quality and delivery.
* Represent Moative’s technology with practice owners, partners and investors, explaining technical choices and their implications for practice economics.

Who you are

You are a technology leader who has built products and remains close to engineering. You can decide what to build with a practice owner, examine an architecture with an engineer and explain investment choices to an executive or investor.

You have worked with fragmented operational systems, inconsistent data and workflows that depend on people’s judgment. You investigate how work is actually done before deciding what to automate, and you understand that reliable data and clear processes are foundations for useful AI.

You have built and scaled products or a technology business, made decisions with incomplete information and stayed accountable for customer adoption and commercial outcomes. You can develop strong technical leaders while stepping into difficult engineering problems when needed.

You want to build the technology foundation of an AI MSO and take responsibility for how it performs as the business grows.

Skills & Requirements

Must have

* At least 15 years of relevant engineering and technology leadership experience, with recent hands-on involvement in architecture, solution design, prototyping and production troubleshooting.
* Experience building and scaling a product or technology business in a founding, CTO or senior engineering leadership role, with clear evidence of customer adoption, commercial outcomes and your own contribution.
* Experience owning product and technology decisions from customer discovery through production, adoption and ongoing improvement.
* Deep experience integrating, cleaning and modeling fragmented operational data, including building reusable platforms serving multiple customers with clear data isolation and access boundaries.
* Experience leading teams that deploy and support AI in live operations, including LLM-based applications or agents, with evaluation, monitoring and human escalation.
* Strong Python, SQL and cloud architecture skills across at least one platform—AWS, Azure or GCP—with the ability to review code, challenge designs and build prototypes.
* Experience delivering healthcare or RCM products, with practical understanding of billing workflows, claim submission, payer interactions, denials, appeals and payment posting.
* Experience establishing technical controls for sensitive healthcare data, including access management, audit trails, secure logging, vendor access and incident response.
* Experience building engineering and data teams, hiring senior technical leaders and establishing engineering standards.
* Experience owning technology budgets, vendor decisions and operating costs, and explaining investment trade-offs in business terms.
* Experience working directly with CXOs, founders and investors to agree priorities, resolve conflicting expectations and communicate technical risk.
* Ability to demonstrate a product you chose to build, the architecture and team you developed, the trade-offs you made and the results achieved.

Preferred experience

* Experience building for US outpatient practices, MSOs or RCM companies, including working with US billing teams and payer workflows.
* Experience taking a company through an acquisition, merger or other successful exit, including technical diligence and transition responsibilities.
* Experience turning services engagements or client-specific solutions into reusable products and platforms.
* Experience with healthcare data exchange and integrations involving claims, remittances, EHRs, practice-management systems or clearinghouses.
* Experience with process mining, operational knowledge systems or adapting smaller models for domain-specific tasks.
* Experience building browser automation or voice agents for operational workflows.

**Location: Chennai or Bangalore.**

Chennai preferred. This role involves regular in-person collaboration with our founders and the healthcare AI pod.

Working at Moative

Moative is a young company, but we believe strongly in thinking long-term, while acting with urgency. Our ethos is rooted in innovation, efficiency and high-quality outcomes. We believe the future of work is AI-augmented and boundaryless. Here are some of our guiding principles:

* **Think in decades. Act in hours.**

  As an independent company, our moat is time. While our decisions are for the long-term horizon, our execution will be fast – measured in hours and days, not weeks and months.
* **Own the canvas.**

  Throw yourself in to build, fix or improve – anything that isn’t done right, irrespective of who did it. Be selfish about improving across the organization – because once the rot sets in, we waste years in surgery and recovery.
* **Use data or don’t use data.**

  Use data where you ought to but not as a ‘cover-my-back’ political tool. Be capable of making decisions with partial or limited data. Get better at intuition and pattern-matching. Whichever way you go, be mostly right about it.
* **Avoid work about work**

  . Process creeps on purpose, unless we constantly question it. We are deliberate about committing to rituals that take time away from the actual work. We truly believe that a meeting that could be an email, should be an email and you don’t need a person with the highest title to say that out loud.
* **High revenue per person.**

  We work backwards from this metric. Our default is to automate instead of hiring. We multi-skill our people to own more outcomes than hiring someone who has less to do. We don’t like squatting and hoarding that comes in the form of hiring for growth. High revenue per person comes from high quality work from everyone. We demand it.

We’d love to hear about a product you helped build and scale, ideally in healthcare or another regulated, data-intensive industry—covering the customer problem, key decisions, team, challenges, results, and your role. Founding or exit experience is welcome. Please share only authorized information; anonymized examples work well.

title: Cloud Security Architect
description:
**About Cognizant**
Cognizant is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
  
  
At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose, always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping the future of business. Could you be the one to make a difference?
  
  
**About The Role**
As a
**Cloud Security Architect**
, you will lead the design, validation, and governance of security architecture across enterprise cloud and hybrid environments. You will play a critical role in ensuring cloud-native and hybrid architectures align with Cognizant’s security reference architecture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multi-cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  
  
You will work independently with senior stakeholders, enterprise architects, security teams, cloud engineering teams, DevSecOps practitioners, and compliance leaders to provide end-to-end ownership of cloud security architecture from threat modeling and design reviews through implementation validation and operational governance. You will have the opportunity to influence strategic cloud adoption initiatives, modern security architectures, and enterprise-wide cloud governance programs while mentoring teams and driving security excellence.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Govern the security architecture of enterprise cloud and hybrid environments across Azure, AWS, GCP, and OCI platforms.
* Conduct cloud security architecture reviews covering Identity and Access Management (IAM), Privileged Identity Management (PIM), network segmentation, micro-segmentation, and Zero Trust security models.
* Partner with Cloud Management Office, enterprise architecture, security, and engineering teams to integrate security requirements into cloud design and architecture decisions.
* Define and implement cloud security standards, architectural patterns, governance controls, and security guardrails.
* Embed security requirements into Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud automation frameworks.
* Collaborate with compliance and risk stakeholders to ensure cloud solutions meet regulatory and security requirements.
* Evaluate emerging cloud services, container platforms, serverless technologies, and AI-enabled solutions while providing architectural guidance and security recommendations.
* Serve as the primary security architecture liaison between enterprise architecture, security governance, control validation, IT security, and business stakeholders.
* Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level objectives (SLOs) for cloud architecture initiatives.
* Lead architecture governance reviews, risk assessments, threat modeling exercises, and solution validation activities.
* Mentor security, architecture, cloud, and engineering teams on secure cloud operations and cloud security best practices.
* Stay current on cloud provider roadmaps, threat landscape developments, regulatory requirements, and industry security standards.

**What You Must Have To Be Considered**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience in information security and cybersecurity architecture.
* 8+ years of experience securing enterprise cloud environments across Azure, AWS, GCP, and/or OCI.
* Proven experience designing and governing cloud security architectures for large-scale enterprise deployments.
* Demonstrated experience leading cloud architecture security reviews and evaluating security controls against cloud frameworks and assurance programs.
* Experience implementing and governing cloud security requirements within DevSecOps environments.
* Strong expertise in cloud security architecture, threat modeling, risk management, and security governance.
* Experience working with enterprise architecture, compliance, risk, audit, and operational stakeholders.
* Experience managing, mentoring, and guiding architecture, engineering, or validation teams.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and strategic planning skills.
* A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for improving the security posture of cloud environments.
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do the Right Thing, and Own It.

**These Will Help You Succeed**

* Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure, including Landing Zones, Azure Policy, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Palo Alto Cortex, API Security, DSPM, Zscaler and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Working knowledge of AWS and Google Cloud Platform security services and governance frameworks.
* Experience with container platforms including AKS, EKS, and GKE.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes security, RBAC, network policies, and service mesh technologies.
* Strong cloud networking expertise including VNet/VPC design, hub-and-spoke architectures, ExpressRoute, Direct Connect, firewall controls, and micro-segmentation.
* Expertise in Zero Trust Architecture, IAM, PIM, Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), and SIEM/SOAR integrations.
* Experience with security and compliance frameworks including PCI DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, NIST CSF 2.0, NIST SP 800-53, and Cyber Essentials Plus.
* Experience using Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates, CloudFormation, GitOps, and CI/CD security controls.
* Proficiency in PowerShell, Python, Bash, and cloud automation practices.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving abilities.
* Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Leadership experience coaching and mentoring architects, engineers, and security practitioners.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP).
* Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) or Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK).
* Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500) or equivalent AWS Certified Security – Specialty or GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer certification.
* Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100).
* Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300).
* Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) or equivalent AWS or GCP Professional Architect certification.
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA).

**Work Model**
We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring attendance at a client or Cognizant office as determined by business needs. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance
description:
**Job Title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance**
**GCL: D3**
**Introduction To Role**
Do you want to build the clear routes that ensure secure delivery becomes the standard across a global enterprise? Can you turn sophisticated security and compliance controls into simple, reusable developer experiences that teams love to adopt?
  
  
In this role, you will develop the outspoken pipelines, infrastructure modules, and automation that power efficient, secure software delivery at scale. Your work will reduce friction for engineering teams, embed security-by-design from the start, and accelerate the delivery of technology that underpins life-changing science for patients worldwide.
  
  
You will partner closely with engineering, security, architecture, and operations to shape enterprise-grade platform capabilities—hands-on and end-to-end. Expect to start by shipping high-impact, reusable assets and evolve into guiding standards and adoption across hundreds of engineers, always balancing deep technical difficulty with practical, outcome-focused delivery.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Golden Paths & Shared GitHub Actions: Design, build, and version enterprise-grade shared GitHub Actions (Composite Actions and Reusable Workflows) and standardized delivery templates to create secure, automated "Golden Paths" across product teams.
* Reusable Infrastructure-as-Code: Build and maintain secure, modular Terraform modules and IaC assets, versioned and documented for broad reuse and easy consumption.
* Embedded DevSecOps Controls: Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM generation, and supply chain protections into default delivery workflows, shifting security left through automation and policy-as-code guardrails.
* Secure CI/CD Patterns: Create scalable, resilient CI/CD patterns aligned to enterprise standards, applying least privilege and reducing configuration risk to strengthen operational reliability.
* Automation and Internal Tooling: Develop automation services and developer tooling in Python or Golang that enable self-service onboarding, secure defaults, and consistent quality checks.
* Multi-Environment Architecture: Chip in to solutions spanning cloud, serverless, containerized, compute, and hybrid environments, producing reference architectures, diagrams, and implementation guidance that accelerate adoption.
* Testing and Quality Engineering: Define and execute testing strategies for infrastructure code and automation (unit, integration, and environment validation) to ensure repeatable, high-quality delivery.
* Adoption and Continuous Improvement: Partner with product and platform consumers to drive adoption, capture feedback, and iterate on patterns and assets to enhance developer experience and business value.
* AI-Enabled Engineering: Apply AI tools and techniques where appropriate to improve development speed, quality, secure design, and innovation, sharing learning and elevating team practices.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Significant 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or a related technical engineering discipline.
* GitHub Actions Platform Development: Hands-on experience authoring, testing, and maintaining centralized, reusable GitHub Actions (Composite Actions, Reusable Workflows) across an enterprise organization.
* Pipeline Versioning & Security: Understanding of Semantic Versioning for GitHub Actions (@v1, @v2), supply chain pinning, and securing pipeline-to-AWS authentication using OpenID Connect (OIDC)
* Strong experience with AWS, including services related to compute, networking, security, and serverless architectures.
* Advanced expertise in Terraform and reusable infrastructure-as-code design.
* Strong scripting or software engineering capability in Python or Golang.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles and controls, including SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM, and software supply chain security.
* Experience designing and implementing secure CI/CD pipelines within enterprise environments.
* Solid grasp of security-by-design, the least privilege, and secure architecture principles.
* Experience building scalable, reusable, modular platform solutions rather than one-off implementations.
* Ability to create clear and effective user documentation and architecture artefacts.
* Collaboration skills and ability to work optimally across engineering, security, and architecture teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant certifications in cloud, security, infrastructure, or DevOps/DevSecOps would be advantageous.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration technologies.
* Exposure to hybrid or on-premises environments.
* Familiarity with Azure cloud services.
* Knowledge of modern application stacks such as Java, .NET, or React.
* Experience applying AI tools to development, testing, secure design, or engineering productivity improvement.
* Experience with infrastructure testing frameworks such as Terratest.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world.

You will navigate significant complexity while building features that require changes across various services and pages, including eBooks purchase and store experiences for digital products. * You will interface with product manager & stakeholders to understand the business requirements.

* You don’t settle for the status quo, and routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve your team’s operations.
* We embrace the challenges of a fast paced market and evolving technologies and making decisions to provide the best buying experience to our customers.
* You will be encouraged to see the big picture, be innovative, and positively impact millions of customers.
* Successful candidates for this position will have a background in Java or C++. Equally important to these specific skills is a candidate's ability to multi-task, adapt quickly to new development environments and changing business requirements, learn new systems, gain new skills, create reliable & maintainable code, and find creative, scalable solutions to difficult problems.

title: AI Security Architect - Hyperscaler & Cloud AI Platforms
description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**
Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
  
  
At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose, always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping future of business. Could you be the one to make a difference?
  
  
**About The Role**
As an
**AI Security Architect - Hyperscaler & Cloud AI Platforms**
, you will drive impactful contributions and focus on outcomes. You will be a key member of the
**AI Security Engineering & Enablement (AISE)**
team, collaborating with IT AI Architects, business unit solution teams, platform engineering teams, cloud security stakeholders, and hyperscaler architects. You will have the autonomy to lead, innovate, and improve workflows while upholding our commitment to quality and continuous learning. As a team of self-starters, you can work with impact with our vibrant people and culture while enjoying unmatched learning opportunities.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own and maintain AI security reference architectures across Azure, AWS, and GCP AI service stacks, covering deployment patterns, network boundaries, identity, data flows, and guardrail integrations.
* Define and maintain security baselines for AI platforms and services, including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot, Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Vertex AI, and GCP Gemini services.
* Conduct STRIDE-based threat modelling for hyperscaler AI platforms and develop platform-specific security controls, standards, and implementation requirements.
* Co-design secure AI solutions with IT AI Architects and delivery teams, providing architecture guidance, security blueprints, design reviews, and security sign-off as formal AISE deliverables.
* Lead the development of AI-native security patterns, including identity architectures, data protection controls, AI supply chain security requirements, guardrail integration blueprints, and secure infrastructure deployment models.

Embrace our vibrant culture by striving for excellence, focusing on meaningful outcomes, and collaborating effectively. Prioritize quality, stay curious, and commit to continuous learning. Take ownership, build relationships, and focus on personal growth to drive business strategy and foster an inclusive culture, creating unmatched career opportunities and impactful work.
  
  
**What You Must Have To Be Considered**

* 10+ years of experience in cloud security architecture, including at least 3 years focused on AI/ML security within public cloud environments.
* Deep hands-on experience with at least two of the following platforms: Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Amazon Bedrock, or Vertex AI, including security configuration, network isolation, and identity architecture design.
* Proven experience developing and implementing enterprise-scale cloud security reference architectures and technical security standards.
* Strong threat modelling expertise using STRIDE and familiarity with MITRE ATLAS and OWASP LLM Top 10 as applied to cloud-hosted AI systems.
* Experience designing identity architectures for AI workloads, including managed identities, OAuth 2.0 client credentials flows, workload identity federation, RBAC, and ABAC models.
* Strong understanding of cloud data security controls, including encryption, data residency requirements, tokenization, VPC architectures, and private endpoint designs.
* Experience addressing AI supply chain risks, including model provenance, software bills of materials (SBOM), dependency management, and model registry security.
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, or CloudFormation and integrating security requirements into infrastructure delivery pipelines.
* A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for work that serves a greater good for customers, communities, or global challenges.

**These will help you succeed**

* Experience implementing prompt injection defenses and guardrail controls at the platform or API gateway layer, including Azure APIM content filtering, Amazon Bedrock Guardrails, or Vertex AI safety controls.
* Experience securing agentic AI workflows and multi-agent orchestration platforms, including LangGraph, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.
* Industry certifications such as AZ-500, SC-100, AWS Security Specialty, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, or equivalent credentials.
* Familiarity with AI-specific detection and telemetry capabilities, including Azure Monitor AI logging, CloudTrail monitoring for Bedrock workloads, and Vertex AI audit logging.
* Experience in consulting, managed security services, product security, or enterprise AI adoption programs operating at scale.
* Ability to influence technical design decisions and collaborate effectively with hyperscaler solution architects and engineering teams.

**Work model – Hybrid**
We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring attendance at a Cognizant or client office as determined by business needs. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Associate Technical Lead, HPC Software
description:
**Company Overview**
KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
  
  
**Group/Division**
With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The Surfscan group includes a team of engineers, technology development, apps engineers and product marketing focused on technology that enables wafer, IC and equipment manufacturers to develop, qualify and monitor their process tools. Defects and process non-uniformities detected on Surfscan equipment allow for early identification of yield excursions. The flagship Surfscan products include the SPx platforms for wafer surface quality and wafer defect inspection tools and systems for inspection of polished wafers, epi wafers and engineered substrates during the wafer fabrication process.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**

* Understand and make design and architectural improvements on existing software
* Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors.
* Ensuring that detailed designs, code, and unit tests, are consistent, robust, future-proof and scalable.
* In conjunction with the Technical Manager, identify, highlight, review and mitigate technical risks
* Must be able to interact and communicate with all levels of staff and project management in both the business and the technical areas, with the ability to keep discussions at the appropriate level of abstraction.
* Possess excellent analytical, problem solving, organizational, interpersonal, and motivational skills, with the ability to move cleanly from theoretical to implementation thinking.
* Excellent communication, inter-personnel skills and team co-ordination skills
* Willingness to travel to US and other customer places on short assignments
* Providing technical expertise to the estimation process as input to the project plan
* Provide Technical assessment of the impact of any changes to product requirements
* Participate in requirements definition and review process.
* Acquire knowledge of key use cases in Bare wafer inspection (IC & Wafer customers)
* Thorough knowledge of SDLC and Software Engineering Principles

**Qualifications**
Minimum 5 to 12 years of experience in Software Development - Strong academics in BE / B Tech / MTech / MCA / MS (CS/IT)
  
  
Other Technical Requirements:
  
  

* Diverse Experience in OO analysis, design, development and unit testing
* Good in programming fundamentals, C++, STL and Boost Library
* Hands-on experience in measuring and optimizing (e.g. via assembly coding, vectorization, SSE or Intel IPP) application performance. Addressing issues that may arise due to I/O, network performance and memory mgmt
* Linux Shell scripting
* Strong Operating System fundamentals - LINUX OS/Kernel Internals
* Knowledge of Socket programming, distributing processing and MPI (message passing interface)
* Good understanding of Parallel Computing concepts using multi-core and GPU.
* Strong Understanding of Linux Performance Profiling and Troubleshooting
* GDB debugging Internals
* Exposure in developing cloud-native applications
* Experience with technologies including Kubernetes, Dockers, containers, virtualization techniques and technologies
* Experience with open-source technologies for Messaging Framework(KAFKA, ActiveMQ or NATS), serialization (binary(protobuf), rpc communication (Corba, grpc)

**Minimum Qualifications**
Doctorate (Academic) , Master's Level Degree or work experience of 2 years , Bachelor's Level Degree or work experience of 3 years

title: Senior SAP Consultant
description:
SAP BTP Developer (CAP + Fiori/UI5 + Integration Suite)

Location: Remote / Hybrid

Type: Full-time / Contract

Experience: 8+ years

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on SAP BTP Developer to design and build cloud-native applications, custom Fiori apps, and integrations on the SAP Business Technology Platform. This is a development role — you will be writing code (CAP services, UI5 apps, integration flows) day to day, not administering systems or deploying standard apps. The candidate should have hands-on experience in SAP and should or may have expertise in these modules. You will work alongside functional consultants and architects to turn business requirements into clean, scalable extensions that sit outside the S/4HANA core.

Develop custom SAP Fiori / UI5 applications — views, controllers, OData models, custom controls

Design and expose OData (v2/v4) services and consume SAP and third-party APIs

Build and maintain integration flows in SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration (CPI) — iFlows, mappings, adapters, API Management

Implement authentication and security on BTP (XSUAA, IAS, destinations, Cloud Connector, roles and scopes)

Participate in code reviews, testing, CI/CD, and production support

Write technical specifications and maintain documentation

Must-Have

8+ years building applications on SAP BTP with hands-on SAP experience

Hands-on SAP CAP development — building services with CDS entities in Java

Hands-on SAP Fiori / UI5 development — custom apps you have coded

OData service development and consumption

SAP Integration Suite / CPI — building integration flows

Integration with SAP S/4HANA via OData / APIs

Working knowledge of BTP security — XSUAA, IAS, destinations, Cloud Connector

Proficiency in Java

Comfortable with SAP Business Application Studio and Git-based workflows

Nice-to-Have

SAP HANA Cloud / HDI containers, CDS modeling

Event-driven architecture — Event Mesh / Advanced Event Mesh, CQRS, outbox pattern

SAP Build (Apps / Process Automation / Work Zone)

SAP Joule / Business AI — building Skills/Agents (strong differentiator)

ABAP RAP / CDS (for S/4HANA core extensions)

CI/CD pipelines and DevOps for BTP

SAP certification in BTP, CAP, or Fiori

description:

Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
  
  
Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.

The team serves as the single point of contact for all security, privacy, and compliance-related customer engagements within the Genesys Cloud Business Unit.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Senior
**AI Cloud Security Architect**
to join the Genesys Global Security, Privacy & Compliance Centre of Excellence (COE SPC) as a technical Security Subject Matter Expert (SME). This is a hands-on, customer-facing technical security role, not a compliance or GRC position. You will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Product Security, and Architecture teams to support consulting, customer audits, security assessments, technical reviews, executive briefings, and evidence-based engagements for Genesys Cloud.
  
  
As one of the team's technical security SMEs, you will apply your expertise in cloud security, AI security, and security controls to explain and defend the Genesys Cloud security, privacy, and compliance posture. You will interpret technical evidence, respond to complex security inquiries, defend security contractual terms, and engage directly with customers, partners, auditors, and executive stakeholders within the APAC region.
  
  
This role is highly consultative and requires excellent English communication and presentation skills. You will regularly represent Genesys Cloud during customer executive briefings, security workshops, webinars, conferences, partner events, and industry forums. You must be comfortable presenting complex technical security concepts to audiences ranging from security practitioners and architects to CISOs, CIOs, and other senior executives, both remotely and in person, to any of our global customers.

* Lead customer-facing security discussions with customers, prospects, partners, auditors, and internal stakeholders on Genesys Cloud architecture, penetration testing, vulnerability management, remediation, privacy, compliance, and AI security.

* Own complex customer security, privacy, and compliance matters and contractual security negotiations.
* Represent Genesys at strategic customer engagements, partner events, conferences, webinars, and industry forums across APAC, contributing to external security thought leadership.

**This Role Offers**

* A highly technical, customer-facing Cloud Security Architect role within a global Centre of Excellence.
* Collaboration with Engineering, Product Security, Architecture, Privacy, Compliance, and AI teams.
* Exposure to complex enterprise cloud environments and leading global customer security organisations.
* The opportunity to shape customer trust in Genesys Cloud and its AI capabilities through technical assurance, executive engagement, and industry representation.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 7+ experience cybersecurity, cloud security, application security, security architecture, or related technical security disciplines.
* Strong practical expertise in AWS security, cloud-native architectures, APIs, Kubernetes, and modern SaaS security models.
* Proven experience designing, securing, operating, or assessing enterprise cloud environments and cloud-native applications.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI, conversational AI, or other AI-enabled application architectures, including their security and data-protection risks.
* Practical knowledge of modern AI security threats and controls, including prompt injection, data leakage, insecure output handling, excessive agency, model and tool abuse, identity and authorization risks, and AI supply-chain dependencies.
* Experience applying recognized AI security guidance, including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and OWASP Agentic AI security guidance.
* Strong understanding of identity and access management, encryption, data protection, API security, vulnerability management, threat modelling, and DevSecOps practices.
* Working understanding of privacy and compliance considerations associated with enterprise AI, particularly data handling, access, retention, transparency, governance, and third-party AI services.
* Experience supporting enterprise security assessments, technical due diligence, audits, customer assurance, or customer-facing security engagements.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical security and AI concepts clearly to both highly technical teams and senior executives.

**Nice-to-Have Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience designing, deploying, securing, integrating, or operating enterprise virtual agents/assistants (AVAs), conversational AI, AI agents, or similar AI-powered customer experience solutions.
* Experience taking AI-enabled applications into production, including API/tool integrations, identity and authorization, data flows, guardrails, observability, monitoring, and operational security.
* Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, threat modelling, AI security assessments, or model/application evaluation frameworks.
* Experience assessing AI systems against emerging AI governance, privacy, security, or regulatory requirements.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code, security automation, CI/CD security, or cloud security engineering.
* Experience working with enterprise contact-centre, conversational AI, customer experience, or communications platforms.
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty, CISSP, CCSP, GIAC, or comparable security certifications.
* Understanding of ISO/IEC 42001 and AI management system principles.

**Working at Genesys**

* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work

About Comcast Next Generation Access Networks (NGAN) NGAN (Next Gen Access Networks) is a group within Headquarters at Comcast that partners with all three divisional Engineering & Technical Operations teams to drive expansion, new technologies and continuous improvement into the ‘last mile’ of the network.
  
  
**Job Description**
Job Description
  
  
Are you passionate about digital media, entertainment, and access technologies? Do you like big challenges and working within a highly motivated team environment?
  
  
The Next Gen Access Technologies team is a small and fast-moving team of world-class experts who are innovating in end-to-end IP services delivery. As a senior integration engineer on the next gen access team, you will design and develop software orchestration solutions used in our new product testing lab to verify the technology that will enable next generation services to our customers. We are a team that thrives on big challenges, results, quality, and agility.
  
  
**Who does the Next Gen Access Technologies team work with?**
The team manages new technology development and deployment programs that require coordination across multiple teams. There is a strong, collaborative relationship between Next Gen Access, developers, vendors, QA engineers, deployment and operations teams as partners in the delivery of quality systems and services. We work at all levels of the organization to plan and deliver new services and service capabilities.
  
  
**What are some interesting problems you’ll be working on?**
In this role, you will be part of a team that is responsible for the development of automated software suites that validate Comcast’s next generation access network capabilities in an R&D test lab environment. You will automate time-consuming manual test processes by orchestrating data flows from a variety of systems to build a “big picture” of the system state as it progresses though operational modes. In addition, you will work with the system engineers on developing applications for debugging and monitoring live systems in the field.
  
  
**Where can you make an impact?**
You’ll be working with the best and brightest minds in Comcast to verify the access networks infrastructure and products that will power the next generation of services. Success in this role is characterized by a higher speed to market as well as fewer customer-facing defects and outages of equipment and services that delight and entertain our customers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop solutions to convert manual data-gathering processes across multiple systems and devices to fully automated, reliable software tools
* Develop tools to integrate parallel data streams from a variety of APIs, tools, logs, and systems into a cohesive unit using a variety of technologies.
* Develop tools to orchestrate device interactions on multiple systems.
* Develop tools to assist the system engineers in debugging and monitoring systems in the field.
* Work collaboratively on a small development team.
* Be available for live meetings with USA-based team members, usually in the evening, local time.
* Participate with fellow team members and the test leads during the automation design phase.
* Support the lab test team in the execution of automated tools you develop.

**Skills & Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering or equivalent work experience.
* 6-8 years of software development.
* Strong preference for experience with business process automation, EIA, and other software orchestration technologies and Python based automation frameworks.
* Strong preference for experience with asynchronous programming
* Experience with front-end system development like React
* Experience with regular expressions and predictive text data processing
* Experience with cable network architecture, specification, engineering, validation a plus.
* Experience with AI Agent, Skill, MCP is a plus
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Keen attention to detail and high level of commitment.

Bachelor's Degree

title: Principal Architect - Payments & Ledger
description:
YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions - YouTrip and YouBiz - empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum's Global Innovator 2025, CNBC's World's Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn's Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions. 

Job Description: Principal Architect, Payments & Ledger

You'll own the architectural direction for money movement end to end: multi-currency wallets and balances, the core ledger, card issuing and authorisation, in-app FX, overseas transfers and payouts, treasury and pre-funding, settlement and reconciliation, and the shared platform services underneath them. Your remit covers both YouTrip (consumer) and YouBiz (business), across every market we operate in.

Responsibilities:

* The Ledger - Double-entry design, chart of accounts, sub-ledger boundaries, immutability and correction rules, multi-currency representation, precision and rounding policy, and how balances are derived or stored. You'll define how we handle authorisation holds, reversals, partial and incremental captures, refunds, FX revaluation and unreconciled positions, and you'll be able to explain and defend those choices to Finance, auditors and regulators
* Money movement correctness -  Idempotency, exactly-once outcomes on top of at-least-once messaging, clear state machines for every transaction type, and well-defined failure, retry, timeout and compensation paths. For every integration, the question "what happens if the partner succeeds and we fail?" should have a written answer that you own
* Card issuing - Architecture for authorisation, clearing and settlement as a Mastercard Principal Member, including real-time authorisation on the scheme's critical path, stand-in processing, authorisation expiry, disputes and chargebacks, tokenisation for Apple Pay and Google Pay, virtual and physical card lifecycle, and the strict latency and availability targets that come with it
* FX and multi-currency wallets - Rate sourcing, quoting and rate locking, spread and exposure management, in-app currency exchange across our wallet currencies, and pre-funding and liquidity models that keep customers' balances safe and available
* Cross-border transfers - Corridor architecture, payout rail integrations (local real-time rails, bank transfers, SWIFT and partner networks), pre-funding and nostro design, and sanctions and AML screening built in as a core design constraint, not an afterthought
* Reconciliation and settlement - We treat reconciliation as an architecture problem, not an operations task. You'll design systems where breaks are rare, spotted within minutes, and traceable to a clear cause, across multiple time zones, currencies and partners
* Non-functional requirements - Latency, throughput, availability and cost as design targets with numbers attached. Clear, written decisions on where eventual consistency is acceptable and where it isn't. Recovery, replay and backfill as built-in capabilities
* Standards and technical judgement - Engineering and coding standards, architecture reviews for significant changes, and architecture documentation that engineers actually build from. You'll write decision records that capture the reasoning and the options rejected, and keep them current
* Partners and vendors - Technical evaluation and ongoing oversight of card processors, scheme connectivity, banking and settlement partners, FX liquidity providers, payout partners, KYC and screening vendors, and core infrastructure. You'll know their systems' failure modes as well as their own architects do
* Growing technical leaders - You'll mentor tech leads and senior engineers from day one and lead mostly through influence. As the function matures, you'll build and lead a small architecture group

**Requirements**

* Deep payments and ledger experience (essential) - You've designed or substantially rebuilt a production financial ledger. You can speak from real experience about journal design, posting models, balance consistency and correction strategies, including what happens when they go wrong
* Card issuing expertise - Hands-on experience with card scheme integrations (ideally Mastercard), issuer processing, authorisation flows, clearing files, and disputes
* A builder, not just an advisor - You've written production code at scale, and your work sits behind systems that handled real traffic and real money. Your authority comes from having shipped
* Range from system to field level - You're equally comfortable designing distributed settlement flows and deciding the type and precision of a single amount field, often in the same week
* Regulated-environment fluency - Experience with safeguarding and customer fund segregation, payment and e-money licensing, data residency, auditability and technology risk requirements, ideally including MAS and other Asia Pacific regulators. You design ahead of regulatory and scheme changes instead of reacting to them
* Multi-market experience - You've built systems that operate across several countries, currencies and regulators at once
* Strong writing - Clear, structured, opinionated documents that remain useful long after the meeting ends. Documentation is part of the work, not a follow-up task
* Opinions you can defend - Clear positions on design patterns, standards and trade-offs, explained just as well to a new graduate as to the board
* Credibility with partners - You can tell when a vendor's recommendation serves them more than us, and you can make that case with evidence
* Experience with Golang, event-driven architectures and cloud-native infrastructure is a plus

What This Role Is Not

This isn't a diagramming role, and it isn't a review gate that approves other people's work without contributing to it. It's also not an engineering management role with large headcount or delivery ownership, though its influence is comparable. If you're looking to run a large organisation, we have other roles for that.

What You Can Expect From Us

* The chance to shape the core money platform of Asia Pacific's leading multi-currency wallet, used by millions of people and businesses
* Some of the most interesting payments challenges in the region, across multiple markets, currencies, partners and regulators
* A company that is committed to getting the architecture right, not just shipping fast
* A culture that values technical craft, direct feedback and getting things done

To Apply

If you're interested in this role, click Apply Now and send us your CV. Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

description:

title: Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
Team owns the layer between clients and backend workloads: proxy and L7 services, API Gateway, and inference gateway for AI traffic. Every request to backend services passes through this layer, so latency, availability, and correctness here directly affect everything downstream. You'll build and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own these services end to end, from design through production operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Problems the team works on:**

* Proxy and L7: request routing, TLS termination, connection management, config propagation across a large fleet, and keeping tail latency predictable under load.
* API Gateway: authentication and authorization, rate limiting and quotas, traffic policies, and giving service teams a safe, self-serve way to expose APIs.
* Inference gateway: routing AI inference traffic, which behaves differently from typical web traffic. Requests are long-running and often streamed, cost varies widely by request, and backend GPU capacity is expensive and limited. That makes routing, queuing, fairness, and capacity efficiency hard problems.

**What you'll do:**

* Build and grow the team: hire engineers and tech leads, set expectations, give direct feedback, and develop people over time.
* Define the team's roadmap and priorities with leadership and partner teams.
* Stay close enough to the technical work to review designs, weigh tradeoffs, and make calls when needed.
* Own the operational health of the services: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and follow-through on reliability work.
* Work closely with networking, security, platform, and ML infrastructure teams on problems that cross team boundaries.

**What we're looking for:**

* Experience managing engineers who build and operate distributed systems in production.
* A solid technical background in at least one of: proxies and load balancing, API gateways, service mesh, networking, or high-throughput backend services.
* Experience running latency-sensitive services, including on-call and incident management.
* Experience building something new, such as starting a team, launching a new service, or taking a product from early design to production.
* A track record of hiring well and helping engineers grow.

**Nice to have:**

* Hands-on experience with Envoy, NGINX or similar.
* Familiarity with LLM inference serving (batching, streaming, GPU utilization).
* Experience building internal platforms used by many engineering teams.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.
