title: Associate Technical Lead, DevSecOps
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Required Skills & Experience**
▪ 4–5 years of experience in DevSecOps, Application Security, Security Engineering, or related roles, with at least 2+ years in a lead or senior technical role.
  
  
▪ Proven experience leading and mentoring security or DevOps engineering teams.
  
  
▪ Expert-level hands-on experience with Checkmarx One (SAST) or equivalent enterprise SAST platforms.
  
  
▪ Deep experience with DAST tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, or commercial alternatives.
  
  
▪ Extensive experience architecting and integrating security tools into Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions at enterprise scale.
  
  
▪ Strong expertise in container security, Kubernetes security, and API security.
  
  
▪ Hands-on experience designing and implementing secrets management solutions (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault).
  
  
▪ Expert understanding of Secure SDLC, OWASP Top 10, SANS Top 25, and enterprise vulnerability management practices.
  
  
▪ Deep experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-native security controls.
  
  
▪ Advanced Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, or Ansible.
  
  
▪ Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and service mesh technologies.
  
  
▪ Proficiency with observability and monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk).
  
  
▪ Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, Go, or PowerShell.
  
  
▪ Experience driving security initiatives in Agile/Scrum and SAFe environments.
  
  
▪ Experience with threat modeling and secure architecture reviews.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
▪ Master’s degree with 4–5 years of relevant experience, or Bachelor’s degree with 6–8 years of experience.
  
  
▪ Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, OSCP, GWAPT, GWEB, or cloud security specialty certifications (AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer).
  
  
▪ Cloud or DevOps certifications (CKS, CKA, AWS DevOps Professional, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert).
  
  
▪ Experience with container and API security platforms (Aqua, Prisma Cloud, Sysdig, Snyk).
  
  
▪ Experience with SIEM platforms (Splunk, Sentinel, Chronicle) and security orchestration (SOAR).
  
  
▪ Experience with zero trust architecture and identity-based security models.
  
  
▪ Background in penetration testing or red team activities.
  
  
▪ Experience presenting to and influencing executive leadership on security strategy and risk.
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
▪ Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence and drive change across teams and organizational boundaries.
  
  
▪ Excellent strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  
  
▪ Outstanding communication skills with the ability to articulate complex security concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
▪ Proven ability to mentor and develop talent.
  
  
▪ Collaborative mindset with experience working in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
  
  
▪ Ownership mentality with a focus on quality, security, and continuous improvement.
  
  
▪ Ability to balance security requirements with business objectives and delivery timelines.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

You are energized by working in a dynamic environment, handling multiple complex projects simultaneously, and translating ambiguous business problems into reliable, production-ready AI systems. You take pride in technical excellence, enjoy mentoring junior team members, and are passionate about advancing state-of-the-art Agentic and LLM architectures within an enterprise scale.What we're looking for… ("You'll need to have…") Bachelor's degree with six or more years of relevant experience. Five or more years of hands-on experience in software engineering, applied machine learning, or advanced data science in production environments. One or more years of hands-on experience architecting, building, and deploying Agentic AI and LLM-driven solutions (e.g., autonomous agents, multi-agent systems, tool calling/function calling, agent workflows). Strong hands-on proficiency with modern AI orchestration and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent agent frameworks. Deep familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture, tool integration standards, REST/gRPC APIs, and microservices design. Expert-level coding proficiency in Python and solid software engineering practices (OOP, design patterns, modular architecture, CI/CD, testing, code quality). Strong experience working with relational, analytical, and streaming data stores: BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka. Solid foundation and working understanding of traditional data science methodologies, predictive modeling, machine learning concepts (supervised/unsupervised learning, neural networks, ensembling), and evaluation metrics. Experience with all phases of an end-to-end AI project lifecycle: data ingestion/streaming, preprocessing, prompt engineering/fine-tuning, model validation/evals, containerization, deployment, operationalization, monitoring, and tracing. Demonstrated track record of leading technical implementation across multiple simultaneous projects and collaborating effectively with cross-functional business and technical stakeholders. Experience providing technical mentorship, conducting architectural and code reviews, and giving feedback to junior engineers and data scientists.What we're looking for… ("Even better if you have…") Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Experience architecting and deploying AI/ML and Agentic solutions in the Telecommunications domain or large-scale enterprise environments. Experience with Vector Databases and advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques (hybrid search, reranking, contextual compression). Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks and guardrail systems Experience with cloud AI platforms (GCP Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI) and distributed compute/data infrastructure. Exceptional presentation, communication, and executive storytelling skills with a proven ability to influence technical and non-technical leadership.Where you’ll be workingIn this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.Scheduled Weekly Hours40Equal Employment OpportunityVerizon is an equal opportunity employer. title: Solution Architect
description:
**Job Description**
**Ciklum**
is looking for a
**Solution Architect**
to join our team full-time in India.
  
  
We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Solution Architect, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. You will be joining a greenfield B2B Marketplace development for Client Procurement Company (VPC) — a centralised procurement entity within the Group based in Luxembourg. The platform is a self service ordering portal for VF WEST deployment partners rolling out fiber-to-home infrastructure across Germany. It replaces fully manual, Excel-based procurement with a governed digital ordering channel integrated into VPC's existing enterprise systems. The solution is built as an API-led web application with a React frontend, .NET backend services, Azure infrastructure, and Entra ID (Azure AD B2C) for authentication. Core integrations include SAP S/4HANA (NSS), WMS (CFL), Transporeon TMS, MDM/MMOLA, and SAP Finance — all via an integration middleware layer. The platform covers end-to-end procurement operations: catalogue and stock visibility, partner-specific pricing, checkout, bulk order upload, allocation-based order governance, shipment tracking, invoicing, returns initiation, operational reporting and automated notifications. The architecture is modular and designed to scale across additional customers and deployment partner networks without redesign.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and own the end-to-end solution architecture for a B2B Marketplace platform integrating with SAP S/4HANA, WMS, TMS, MDM and Azure AD B2C
* Design the integration middleware layer, API contracts and data flow between the Webshop and client backend systems
* Ensure architectural decisions align with enterprise security, scalability and data segregation requirements
* Lead technical discovery sessions with client system owners
* Produce and maintain architecture documentation, integration specs and decision records
* Support engineering teams during implementation to validate alignment with the target architecture
* Participate in pre-sales and client-facing sessions to present and defend technical approach

**Requirements**

* 5+ years in solution or enterprise architecture roles
* Proven experience designing API-led integrations with SAP S/4HANA or equivalent ERP systems
* Strong knowledge of Azure cloud services, Entra ID and API management patterns
* Experience with B2B platform or e-commerce portal architecture
* Ability to produce clear architecture diagrams, integration maps and technical documentation
* Comfortable working in Fixed Price delivery with defined scope boundaries
* Strong communication skills — able to present complex architecture to non-technical stakeholders
* Experience in supply chain, logistics or procurement platforms is a strong advantage

**What’s in it for you?**

* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

**About Us**
At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
  
  
India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.
  
  
**Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!**
Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

title: Specialist, Technology - Software
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The LS-SWIFT division delivers high-throughput patterned wafer inspection systems that support advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to provide industry-leading defect detection with optimal cost of ownership across a wide range of applications. LS systems enable precise, cost-effective inspection for cutting-edge process nodes, while SWIFT systems offer comprehensive macro inspection of all wafer surfaces—capabilities that are especially critical for advanced packaging, as well as logic, memory, and automotive applications.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Strong software architecture expertise designing complex, distributed, scalable, high-performance, and data-intensive systems.
* Experience across legacy and modern technology stacks, with the ability to evolve existing platforms and drive architectural improvements.
* Deep technical knowledge in one or more areas: enterprise architecture, cloud-native services, microservices, AI/ML infrastructure, big data platforms, or DevOps automation.
* Proven ability to design and deliver medium-to-large scale software systems in multi-developer, cross-functional environments.
* Strong systems thinking and analytical skills, capable of simplifying ambiguity, evaluating trade-offs, and solving complex technical challenges.
* Expertise in scalability, performance optimization, reliability, and future-proof software design, ensuring robust architectures, code quality, and maintainability.
* Ability to translate complex business and technical requirements into architecture, detailed designs, and executable engineering plans.
* Strong technical leadership and mentoring skills, influencing architects, senior engineers, and technical leads across organizations, geographies, and disciplines.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, effectively engaging both technical and non-technical stakeholders in global teams.
* Ownership-driven mindset with a focus on execution, innovation, and engineering excellence, leveraging modern development practices and AI-assisted engineering tools.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building and architecting complex distributed systems.
* Familiarity with UI/UX design considerations in engineering applications.

**Technical Skills:**

* Programming: C#, C++, Java, Python, .NET
* Architectural Paradigms: Microservices, service-oriented architecture, modular monolith, layered architecture, event-driven architecture
* Legacy Modernization: Monolith decomposition, migration from thick-client/desktop stacks to modern service-based platforms, backend/frontend separationWorking knowledge of container technologies, orchestration frameworks (e.g., Kubernetes), and workflow automation.Strong grasp of software development best practices, CI/CD, and DevOps principles.
* Leadership & Communication: Demonstrated ability to lead and drive functional teams. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Passion for mentoring and developing engineering talent.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Doctorate (Academic) Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 6 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 8 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Customer Success Technical Architect
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Customer Success Technical Architect (CSTA), you will be a trusted technical advisor to Confluent (an IBM Company) customers after they adopt our platform. You will help customers achieve measurable value from their Confluent investments by improving technical health, accelerating adoption, guiding best-practice decisions, and proactively managing risks across their streaming environments.
  
  
You will work as part of the broader customer account team and partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Support, Product, and Engineering. The role combines technical depth, customer leadership, structured execution, and the ability to translate complex architecture and operational topics into clear business outcomes.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Own customer-facing technical execution for a portfolio of strategic customers, aligning activity to customer goals, adoption plans, and desired business outcomes.
* Build trusted-advisor relationships with technical and business stakeholders, from practitioners and architects to senior leaders.
* Provide proactive guidance on Confluent and Apache Kafka architecture, workload optimization, operational practices, upgrades, reliability, security, governance, and adoption.
* Maintain a regular customer operating rhythm via office hours, quarterly reviews, health checks, roadmap alignment, and enablement.
* Assess technical health, identify adoption blockers and emerging risks, and create clear action plans with owners, milestones, and follow-through.
* Coordinate with Support and other Confluent and IBM teams on escalations, ensuring the customer has a clear path forward and that remediation actions are tracked to completion.
* Help customers prepare for critical events such as upgrades, major launches, architecture changes, and production growth.
* Educate customer teams on Confluent capabilities, recommended practices, and relevant product developments.
* Bring customer feedback and product insights back to Confluent, helping improve the customer experience and inform product direction.
* Contribute to the CSTA practice by sharing technical knowledge, reusable guidance, playbooks, and lessons learned.

**Preferred Education**
Bachelor's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field, or comparable practical background.
* 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Customer Success Architect, Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect, Support Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, or equivalent.
* Ability to discuss application architecture, APIs, networking, security, observability, data integration, and production operations with technical stakeholders.
* Hands on knowledge of one or more key cloud vendors (AWS, GCP and Azure)
* Solid understanding of cloud networking and security technologies (e.g. VPC, Private Link, Private Service Connect, TLS/SSL, SASL, Kerberos, etc.)
* Experience prototyping and analyzing code for client solutions in multiple languages (e.g. Java, Python, Go, etc.)
* Experience with Java Virtual Machine (JVM) tuning and troubleshooting
* Experience with operating Linux, you know how to configure, tune and troubleshoot both RedHat & Debian based distributions
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead structured conversations with both technical teams and executives.
* Ability to manage multiple customer priorities, create clarity in ambiguous situations, and drive actions to completion.
* A proactive, consultative mindset focused on preventing issues and creating customer value rather than only reacting to incidents.
* Willingness to continue learning in a rapidly evolving technical domain and to share knowledge with peers.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Experience helping customers build distributed systems or streaming solutions that use Apache Kafka alongside technologies such as Spark, Flink, Hadoop, Cassandra, etc
* Experience with Apache Kafka & Apache Flink
* Confluent or Apache Kafka certification
* Experience working with global customers

title: Data Architect
description:
**Data Architect – Data Platform Delivery & Client Program Lead**

**Full Time | Chennai |**

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced Data Architect to own the architecture, delivery, and client relationship for a strategic data program at an enterprise manufacturing organization, built on a modern cloud data stack. You will operate within the client's established enterprise architecture design standards and governance frameworks adapting and delivering to those standards rather than building in a greenfield. In areas where standards do not exist, you will have the opportunity to shape & help establish standards.

This is a role that goes well beyond technical design. Alongside architecting and leading hands-on implementation, you will play an account leadership role, own client delivery and stakeholder relationships, contribute to presales, and act as the primary liaison for the data program. Over time, we see your contribution in organizational presales and contributions to multiple accounts.

You will architect and guide solutions across Snowflake, cloud ETL / integration tooling (Informatica IICS, Talend, Boomi), AWS, and enterprise reporting (Cognos, Power BI) while playing a strategic role leading the team and partnering directly with client stakeholders to shape the roadmap and deliver outcomes.

This role suits someone who is technically deep, delivery lead capable, and client-facing, with solid team-management foundations and a genuine appetite to grow as a leader. We will actively support your development in people and delivery management.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Architecture & Solution Design**

· Own the end-to-end data architecture across the client stack: Snowflake, IICS, Talend, Boomi, Qlik Replicate, AWS, Cognos, and Power BI.

· Design scalable, secure, and cost-effective solutions spanning ingestion, integration, data

warehousing, modelling, and reporting.

· Work within the client's enterprise architecture design standards, integration patterns, and

governance frameworks - and contribute to strengthening them where appropriate.

· Architect Snowflake solutions directly, or partner with the client's Snowflake leads to shape

them, while safeguarding governance: cost management, consumption oversight, warehouse.

sizing, and access-management best practices.

· Lead technical implementation and stay hands-on where it matters - reviewing designs,

unblocking the team, and building critical components.

· Own solution design decisions and their trade-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical

and business audiences.

**Delivery & Team Leadership**

· Lead and coordinate a data team of seven across engineering, integration, and BI.

· Plan and run sprints, manage and prioritize the backlog, and keep delivery on track (light

scrum-master responsibilities).

· Own solution delivery from analysis through build, testing, deployment, and support.

· Manage defects, enhancements, and a prioritized improvement roadmap.

· Mentor team members, set technical direction, and support the team's growth.

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

· Own the client relationship and act as the primary liaison for the data program.

· Manage stakeholder communications across internal and external teams.

· Gather requirements directly from business and technical stakeholders; define priorities, KPIs,

and acceptance criteria.

· Own client delivery outcomes and contribute to presales relationships.

· Build solution and proposal decks and present them to executive, business, and technical

audiences.

**Required Skills and Experience**

· 5+ years in data engineering, data integration, or business intelligence, with 1+ years in a data

architecture capacity.

· Strong Snowflake experience - able to architect solutions independently or collaborate closely

with dedicated Snowflake leads to shape them.

· Solid grasp of Snowflake governance concepts: cost management, consumption / credit

oversight, warehouse sizing, and access-management best practices (RBAC, data security).

· Comfortable working within, and delivering to, an established enterprise architecture and

governance framework.

· Strong hands-on experience with cloud ETL / data integration tooling - one or more of

Informatica IICS, Talend, or Boomi - and the ability to design across a mixed toolset.

· Solid experience with AWS data and platform services.

· Experience delivering enterprise reporting and analytics with Cognos and/or Power BI.

· Strong SQL and data modelling skills (dimensional and analytical modelling).

· Demonstrated ability to lead delivery and coordinate a team, with foundational team-

management experience and a clear interest in growing as a people / delivery leader.

· Proven ability to own client relationships and gather requirements directly from business

stakeholders.

· Experience running agile delivery - sprint planning, backlog management, and prioritization.

· Excellent communication skills, able to explain technical concepts clearly to both business and

technical audiences.

· Strong problem-solving, prioritization, and ownership skills.

**Preferred Skills:**

· Experience owning presales and building solution proposal decks.

· Snowflake advanced features and warehouse / cost optimization.

· Experience across multiple ETL / integration tools in the same landscape (IICS + Talend +

Boomi).

· Data governance, security, and role-based access / access-model design.

· Experience delivering into a large, standards-driven enterprise - ideally in manufacturing or a

comparable industrial / operational domain.

· Migration, go-live, or platform-modernization experience.

· Familiarity with ITIL-based incident, problem, and change-management processes.

· Certified Scrum Master or equivalent agile / delivery experience.

**Certifications (one or more preferred - not all required)**

· AWS Certified - Solutions Architect or Data Engineer / Data Analytics

title: Executive Leader, Cloud Platforms & Cyber Resilience
description:
**Location**
Chennai, India; relocation can be discussed

**Experience**
20+ years in technology, including substantial executive leadership

**Reporting**
Senior technology leadership

**The mandate**

An established enterprise software organization is strengthening the way it builds, protects, and operates its cloud services. It is looking for an executive who can bring platform engineering, production resilience, and security outcomes under clear leadership, while working closely with product and engineering teams.

The successful leader will set direction and build a capable organization that delivers dependable services, reduces security exposure, and automates routine operational work. This is a leadership appointment with real technical accountability: the executive will challenge design decisions, examine service and security evidence, and personally engage in critical events when needed.

**What you will own**

An integrated operating model for cloud platforms, service operations, SRE, secure software delivery, and security engineering.

Organization design, leadership development, and measurable accountability across managers and specialist teams.

The executive view of service health, operational risk, security posture, major incidents, and investment priorities.

A close partnership with engineering leaders so reliability and security are built into architecture, development, release, and support.

**Areas of impact**

**Service resilience and operational leadership**

Define how critical services are measured and operated, including SLOs, error budgets, availability, performance, capacity, and release risk.

Lead high-severity incident response and 24x7 escalation. Set expectations for command, communications, root-cause analysis, and completion of corrective work.

Use telemetry, service reviews, readiness practices, and resilience exercises to identify weak signals and prevent customer-impacting failures.

Build repeatable operating practices for change management, on-call readiness, escalation, and continual service improvement.

**Cloud platform and financial stewardship**

Guide the architecture and operating model for OCI or an equivalent major provider such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

Oversee Kubernetes and virtualized environments, microservices foundations, cloud networking, databases, provisioning, and platform lifecycle.

Expand infrastructure as code and policy as code to make environments consistent, reviewable, and controlled.

Ensure backups and disaster recovery are routinely tested against agreed recovery objectives; improve resilience based on exercise results.

Introduce sound cloud financial management through cost allocation, forecasting, capacity choices, rightsizing, and accountable spend.

**Security engineering and threat response**

Own identity and privileged-access practices, secrets handling, and least-privilege design across cloud and engineering environments.

Ensure application and API authorization testing addresses tenant boundaries, isolation, and access-control failures in multi-tenant services.

Operate a risk-based vulnerability program that assigns owners, sets remediation targets, verifies fixes, and escalates overdue exposure.

Maintain cloud security posture management, continuous monitoring, security incident response, and disciplined penetration-test follow-through.

**Secure delivery, assurance, and AI operations**

Work with software engineering to embed automated checks in CI/CD: SAST, DAST, SCA, secret detection, container scanning, and IaC scanning.

Agree practical remediation SLAs and risk exceptions with engineering teams, keeping controls effective and delivery workflows usable.

Maintain operating evidence for ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, and SOC 2; lead customer security assessments and responses.

Apply automation and AIOps to detection, triage, response, and toil reduction. For AI agents, establish identity controls, authorized tool access, isolated execution, complete audit trails, and human approvals for sensitive actions.

**Experience and leadership profile**

At least 20 years of technology experience, with a track record of senior ownership in cloud platforms, production operations, reliability engineering, DevSecOps, or security engineering.

Executive leadership across multiple functions, including managing managers, setting direction, building leadership capability, and delivering outcomes through sizeable teams.

Accountability for business-critical production services; product SaaS or other cloud-native, multi-tenant environments are especially relevant.

Practical depth in a major cloud provider, Kubernetes, microservices, networking, databases, observability, IaC, and recovery planning.

Credible record of leading significant production incidents and converting lessons into lasting changes to architecture, process, or operational readiness.

Applied security engineering experience spanning IAM/PAM, secrets, application and API authorization, vulnerability remediation, cloud posture, monitoring, and response.

Experience introducing automated CI/CD security checks and achieving sustained remediation without relying on manual review as the main control.

Experience leading ISO 27001-family and SOC 2 assurance, including evidence quality and customer-facing security reviews.

Ability to communicate technical risks, trade-offs, service performance, and investment needs clearly to executive stakeholders.

**Additional strengths**

Production experience with OCI; equivalent leadership depth with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud is applicable.

Background in enterprise SaaS or a regulated, security-conscious technology environment.

Relevant cloud, security, SRE, or audit credentials, such as cloud architecture/security certifications, CISSP, CISM, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor.

Demonstrated use of AIOps or AI agents in operational settings with clear boundaries, oversight, and auditability.

title: Digital Architect
description:
CXOntology is looking for a
**Digital Architect**
who can lead solution design and delivery across digital experience programs. The role needs someone who understands CMS platforms, commerce platforms, marketing technology, analytics, and consulting-led delivery.

This person will work with clients, internal delivery teams, stakeholders, and executive teams to define the right solution, guide implementation, own technical direction, and ensure the team delivers business outcomes, not just tasks.

**Minimum Expectations:**

* Experience working on 2+ CMS platforms, such as Drupal/Acquia, Contentful, Contentstack, AEM, Optimizely, Sitecore, or similar.
* Experience with at least one commerce platform, such as Shopify, Adobe Commerce/Magento, BigCommerce, commercetools, or similar.
* Understanding of marketing technology stacks, including CRM, marketing automation, CDP/personalization, campaign operations, and customer journey activation.
* Working knowledge of analytics and measurement, including GA4, GTM, attribution, conversion tracking, dashboards, and KPI reporting.
* Ability to lead strategy and consulting conversations with clients, including discovery, current-state assessment, roadmap definition, and recommendation framing.
* Strong solution design capability across CMS, commerce, integrations, front-end, cloud, analytics, and marketing technology.
* Ability to take delivery ownership for technical decisions, risks, dependencies, estimates, implementation quality, and release readiness.
* Experience collaborating with client stakeholders and executive teams, translating technical choices into business impact.

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Lead architecture and solution design for digital experience, commerce, marketing technology, and analytics-led programs.
* Own technical discovery and translate business goals into clear platform and implementation recommendations.
* Define solution blueprints, integration approaches, technical roadmaps, and delivery plans.
* Guide the delivery team across engineers, QA, DevOps, UX, analytics, and marketing operations teams.
* Review technical designs, unblock delivery teams, and ensure implementation quality.
* Identify platform risks, technical debt, dependencies, and ownership gaps early.
* Support managed services, migrations, CRO, platform optimization, and AI-enabled digital workflows.
* Communicate clearly with client stakeholders, senior leadership, and executive sponsors.

**Required Experience:**

* 7+ years in digital platforms, CMS, commerce, MarTech, web engineering, solution consulting.
* 4+ years in an architect, lead engineer, technical consultant, solution design role.
* Hands-on background in CMS, commerce, integrations, front-end, cloud delivery.
* Strong understanding of performance, accessibility, SEO, security, analytics, QA, and release governance.
* Ability to work across business, technology, marketing, and delivery teams.

**Success In This Role:**

Success means the delivery teams has clear technical direction, the client understands the recommended path, risks are visible early, and delivered solutions improve platform health, customer experience, conversion, and business outcomes.

title: Lead Architect - Data Network
description:
**Company Profile**
**Lennox (NYSE: LII)**
Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry-leading climate-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking a Lead Architect – Network & Data Infrastructure to own the end‑to‑end architecture, governance, and evolution of enterprise network platforms. This role is responsible for defining scalable, secure, and resilient network architectures across LAN, WAN, SD‑WAN, and wireless domains, while ensuring alignment with business objectives, security standards, and operational excellence. The ideal candidate brings deep hands‑on expertise combined with strong architectural judgment, acting as the design authority and senior escalation point for complex network and security challenges. This role plays a critical part in driving modernization, performance optimization, and proactive vulnerability management across the enterprise.
  
  
**Architecture & Design**

* Define and own enterprise network architecture standards, reference designs, and technology roadmaps across LAN, WAN, SD‑WAN, and wireless platforms
* Lead architecture design reviews and provide technical direction for Cisco and Aruba–based solutions
* Translate business, application, and security requirements into scalable and resilient network designs

**Network Engineering & Optimization**

* Design, deploy, and optimize high‑availability network solutions using Cisco and Aruba technologies
* Architect and govern dynamic routing strategies (OSPF, EIGRP, BGP) to ensure performance, resiliency, and scalability
* Architect and optimize Aruba wireless platforms for enterprise‑grade mobility and seamless user experience
* Operational Excellence & Incident Leadership
* Act as the final escalation authority for critical and complex network incidents
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for major incidents and drive corrective and preventive actions
* Collaborate with operations, security, and application teams to minimize downtime and improve MTTR

**Security & Vulnerability Governance**

* Architect network security controls aligned with enterprise security frameworks and industry best practices
* Oversee vulnerability identification, remediation strategy, and lifecycle management using tools such as Rapid7, Nessus, or Qualys
* Ensure patching, hardening, and compliance with security, QoS, and regulatory standards

**Monitoring, Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* Define monitoring and observability standards using tools such as SolarWinds, PRTG, and Fluke
* Drive network performance analytics, capacity planning, and continuous optimization initiatives
* Promote and guide network automation and standardization to improve reliability and operational efficiency

**Documentation, Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Maintain architecture documentation, standards, and design artifacts
* Provide executive‑level reporting on network health, risk posture, vulnerabilities, and improvement initiatives
* Mentor senior engineers and influence cross‑functional teams without direct authority

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field (relevant certifications may substitute).
* 12+ years of progressive experience managing and architecting enterprise‑scale network environments
* Demonstrated experience operating at architect or senior design authority level

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced expertise in Cisco switching, routing, wireless, and SD‑WAN platforms
* Strong command of OSPF, EIGRP, and BGP in large‑scale environments
* Deep knowledge of Aruba wireless architectures and optimization techniques
* Experience with vulnerability management and security assessment tools
* Proficiency with enterprise network monitoring and performance tools
* Exposure to network automation frameworks and scripting

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem‑solving mindset with architecture‑level thinkin
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non‑technical stakeholders
* Proven leadership during high‑severity incidents and transformation initiatives
* Ability to work independently while influencing cross‑functional teams

**Key Competencies**

* Enterprise network architecture & design governance
* Proactive risk, performance, and vulnerability management
* Incident leadership and decision‑making under pressure
* Continuous learning and adoption of emerging network technologies

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP)
* Aruba Certified Mobility Associate (ACMA)
* Aruba Certified SD-WAN Deployment Professional (ACSDP)
* CCIE is a plus

title: Director-Software Engineering-Unify Energy

The Director will partner closely with Product Management, business leadership, Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Data Engineering, Quality Engineering, Implementation, Customer Success, and other software teams. This leader will translate industry needs into an executable engineering strategy, coordinate cross-team dependencies, and ensure that product investments produce measurable customer, operational, and financial outcomes.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on strategic leader with deep experience delivering complex SaaS and cloud-native platforms, leading distributed engineering teams, and building data-intensive solutions for regulated or asset-intensive industries. Oil and gas domain experience is strongly preferred, including familiarity with upstream, midstream, or downstream workflows; land, lease, well, facility, and asset records; regulatory information; document and data onboarding; and integration with industry and enterprise systems.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams responsible for the Unify Energy platform and related software, data, integration, and automation capabilities.
* Own the engineering strategy, technical roadmap, execution plan, and delivery outcomes for Unify Energy in alignment with product strategy, customer commitments, revenue goals, and long-term platform direction.
* Build strong working partnerships with oil and gas business leaders, customers, Product Management, Implementation, and Customer Success to understand industry workflows, prioritize the highest-value problems, and convert business outcomes into clear engineering plans.
* Provide technical leadership across SaaS software engineering, cloud-native architecture, APIs and integrations, data pipelines, search and document services, analytics, workflow automation, and applied AI.
* Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, support, and continuous improvement.
* Drive delivery of scalable, secure, and maintainable capabilities that support energy information ingestion, normalization, indexing, classification, validation, search, retrieval, workflow, and reporting.
* Advance platform capabilities that enable Access to serve as a trusted steward of customers’ physical and digital information assets by supporting metadata management, intuitive search, filtering, navigation, and map-based discovery within the SaaS platform. Lead the data engineering capabilities required to ingest, organize, and enrich customer data so it becomes more accessible, useful, and valuable across oil and gas workflows.
* Guide integration strategy for industry and enterprise systems, including data exchanges, APIs, batch interfaces, identity services, content repositories, GIS or spatial data, analytics platforms, and customer-specific systems of record.
* Lead data engineering and data quality practices for high-volume structured and unstructured information, including ETL/ELT, metadata management, lineage, reconciliation, observability, and reliable downstream consumption.
* Guide responsible use of AI and machine learning to improve document understanding, metadata extraction, classification, entity matching, search relevance, workflow recommendations, quality assurance, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure solutions are designed with appropriate attention to cybersecurity, privacy, records retention, legal hold, auditability, data residency, regulatory obligations, customer controls, and business continuity.
* Establish outcome-based planning and measurement. Define engineering and business KPIs for major initiatives, including delivery predictability, quality, reliability, adoption, customer value, operational efficiency, and revenue or retention impact.
* Partner with Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Quality Engineering, Data Engineering, and Operations to establish technical standards, reusable patterns, release controls, service-level objectives, and operational readiness.
* Monitor portfolio health, delivery metrics, product quality, reliability, risks, dependencies, capacity, and technical debt; make clear tradeoffs and proactively resolve or escalate issues that threaten business outcomes.
* Continuously improve platform architecture, technical health, and integration patterns while protecting customer continuity and sequencing change based on value, risk, and delivery readiness.
* Support talent planning through hiring, coaching, performance management, succession planning, role clarity, and the creation of an accountable, inclusive, and customer-focused engineering culture.
* Represent Unify Energy engineering in executive, product, customer, and governance forums, providing clear updates on strategy, delivery performance, investment needs, risks, opportunities, and decisions required.
* Stay current with emerging trends in energy technology, information management, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data platforms, AI-enabled automation, SaaS architecture, and software delivery practices.

**First 6-12 Months**
The initial focus will be to establish a clear engineering and product delivery baseline for Unify Energy, strengthen alignment between customer needs and the technical roadmap, and improve execution predictability. The Director will assess the platform architecture, team capabilities, operating model, delivery commitments, reliability, security posture, technical debt, and customer integration landscape. They will work closely with Product, Operations, and customer-facing teams to confirm the highest-priority business and product outcomes and translate them into a focused, sequenced delivery plan.
  
  
Success will be demonstrated through clearer accountability, stronger engineering and product operating rhythms, improved delivery and quality metrics, reduced execution risk, deeper customer partnership, and measurable progress on the highest-value Unify Energy capabilities.

* Define and execute the enterprise data platform strategy and roadmap
* Design and evolve a modern AWS native lakehouse architecture
* Establish scalable, reusable data platform patterns and standards
* Drive migration from legacy Microsoft based data platforms
* Define and evolve the federated data operating model, including domain responsibilities and data product standards

* Own delivery and ongoing operation of the data platform
* Oversee development of data ingestion pipelines and transformation frameworks
* Ensure platform reliability, performance, and scalability
* Implement monitoring, observability, and operational controls

* Define and enforce data governance standards, policies, and controls

* Define reference architectures for batch, streaming, and real-time processing
* Standardize orchestration and data processing patterns
* Own integration strategy and interoperability with analytics and BI tools such as Power BI, SQL based platforms, Agentic AI capabilities (e.g., model context protocol, data access patterns for AI workloads)

* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers and analysts
* Establish engineering standards, best practices, and quality frameworks
* Build capabilities in modern data engineering, governance, and platform operations
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Drive alignment with business domains to onboard and scale data products
* Enable self-service data access and consumption
* Drive alignment with architecture, security, and analytics teams
* Act as the primary escalation point for platform related decisions

**Qualifications & Experience**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, or related fields
* 3+ years of experience leading data engineering or platform teams
* Strong hands on experience with AWS data ecosystem:
* S3, Glue, Lake Formation, DataZone, IAM
* Athena, Redshift, or similar query engines
* Experience designing and implementing Lakehouse or modern data platform architectures
* Expertise in data ingestion, ETL/ELT pipelines, and orchestration frameworks
* Strong understanding of data governance, security, and access control models
* Experience with enterprise data cataloging and metadata management

* Experience supporting analytics tools such as Power BI
* Knowledge of data sharing and cross domain data product models
* Exposure to agentic AI capabilities and data access patterns for AI workloads

* Communication and stakeholder management skills
* Delivery ownership and execution focus
* Continuous improvement and innovation mindset

title: Solution Architect - JAVA
description:
**ASSA ABLOY**
is a global leader in access solutions, dedicated to shaping the future of security and convenience. With a rich heritage spanning over 150 years, ASSA ABLOY has built a reputation for delivering innovative and reliable locking and access control solutions. Their diverse portfolio includes well-known brands like Yale, HID Global, and Mul-T-Lock, offering a comprehensive range of products and services to meet the unique needs of customers worldwide. From residential and commercial buildings to critical infrastructure and healthcare facilities, ASSA ABLOY's cutting-edge technologies ensure safety, security, and seamless user experiences. With a commitment to sustainability and customer satisfaction, ASSA ABLOY continues to drive advancements in access solutions for a safer and more connected world.
  
  
**SUMMARY**
:
  
  
The Solution Architect (SA) works within a targeted domain and focuses on the conversion of requirements into software solutions. The SA leverages experience in developing the blueprint for an IT solution, consistent with company standards and industry best practices. Responsibilities include working with business users to define the project scope; developing architecture and detail design; formulating and executing project plans.
  
  
**SUMMARY OF RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Design and define scalable, secure, and high-performance Java-based application architectures.
* Translate application requirements into software solutions that adhere to software architecture and implementation standards.
* Lead architecture discussions and provide technical guidance to development teams.
* Define technology stacks, frameworks, and development standards for projects.
* Design and implement microservices, REST APIs, and integration solutions.
* Review application designs and code to ensure quality, scalability, and compliance with application requirements and implementation standards.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, project managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver software solutions that meet business needs and expectations.
* Ensure application security through industry-standard authentication, authorization, and data protection mechanisms.
* Identify and resolve performance, scalability, and reliability challenges.
* Define database, messaging, and integration architectures to support software solutions.
* Establish architecture governance, best practices, and technical standards across projects.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions to improve business outcomes.
* Mentor developers and technical leads on architecture principles and best practices.
* Conduct architecture reviews, risk assessments, and technical solution evaluations.
* Support project estimation, technical planning, and solution roadmaps.
* Identify technical risks and provide mitigation strategies.
* Develop and finalize solution proposal and/or presentation of recommended solutions.
* Ensure solutions are maintainable, reusable, and aligned with software solution objectives.
* Developing software using JAVA, Spring framework, Hibernate, MySQL, Smart GWT framework.

**RELATIONSHIPS/CONTACTS:**

* Reports directly to the Manager, Application Development.
* Works with employees at all levels of the organization.
* This position does not have any direct reports.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must meet expectations of each essential duty. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills and abilities required.
  
  
**EDUCATION:**
**Preferred Graduate Degree In Computer Science/engineering/information Technology.**
**EXPERIENCE:**

* Minimum 15+ years of progressive experience in Java application development, solution architecture, system design, and enterprise application delivery.
* Minimum 4+ years of experience in a Solution Architect or Technical Architect role, designing and delivering large-scale, mission-critical applications.

**TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE and/or ABILITIES:**

* Extensive experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale applications using Java and related technologies.
* Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate/JPA, and RESTful API development.
* Experience designing and implementing Microservices Architectures and distributed systems.
* Proficiency with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.
* Proficiency with build and dependency management tools such as Maven and Gradle.
* Strong experience with Git-based source code management and branching strategies.
* Expertise in relational databases, data modelling, SQL optimization, and database integration.
* Strong knowledge of application security, authentication, authorization, OAuth2, JWT, and secure coding practices.
* Experience conducting architecture reviews, defining technical standards, and establishing governance frameworks.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented design principles, design patterns, and software architecture best practices.
* Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that align with business and technical objectives.

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Strong leadership and team mentoring skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Experience leading cross-functional, onshore, and offshore teams.
* Ability to drive architecture decisions and technical governance.
* Effective prioritization and multitasking in fast-paced environments.
* Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills.
* Proactive, self-motivated, and results-oriented mindset.
* Ability to manage technical risks and dependencies.
* Commitment to innovation, continuous improvement, and best practices.

**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.
  
  
As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. title: Senior Embedded Software Architect Engineer
description:
**Company**
Qualcomm India Private Limited
  
  
**Job Area**
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
  
  
**General Summary**
As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what is possible to enable next-generation intelligent computing, AI, connectivity, and low-power embedded technologies.
  
  
As a Senior Embedded Software Architect Engineer, you will drive the architecture, design, and evolution of embedded software platforms, developer frameworks, and SDKs that enable internal engineering organizations, OEMs, ISVs, and ecosystem partners to build applications and services across heterogeneous computing environments.
  
  
You will serve as a technical architect responsible for defining scalable Embedded SDK and Agentic SDK strategies spanning multiple operating systems, processors, and software subsystems. This role requires deep expertise across the complete software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and architecture through implementation, validation, commercialization, and long-term platform evolution.
  
  
You will collaborate with software, hardware, AI, systems, security, tooling, and product teams to create developer experiences that accelerate adoption of Qualcomm technologies across mobile, IoT, XR, automotive, industrial, and edge-AI platforms.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
SDK Architecture & Platform Strategy
  
  

* Define the architecture, roadmap, and technical direction for Embedded SDK platforms supporting heterogeneous compute environments.
* Architect reusable software frameworks, APIs, middleware layers, tooling, and runtime environments that operate across multiple operating systems and processor architectures.
* Drive architecture decisions for Agentic SDK platforms enabling autonomous workflows, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, and edge intelligence solutions.
* Establish long-term platform strategies balancing developer productivity, portability, performance, power efficiency, security, and scalability.

Software Architecture
  
  

* Design software architectures supporting Qualcomm SoCs comprising CPUs, DSPs, NPUs, MCUs, accelerators, and secure execution environments.
* Define software decomposition, interface specifications, service boundaries, and integration requirements across subsystems.
* Develop architectural solutions supporting multi-OS deployments including Linux, Android, Zephyr, QuRT, QNX, Windows, and emerging RTOS environments.
* Drive architecture reviews and technical governance processes across multiple engineering organizations.

Software Development Lifecycle Leadership
  
  

* Lead software programs through the complete software development lifecycle including:

+ Requirements analysis
+ Architecture definition
+ Design specification
+ Development
+ Integration
+ Validation
+ Release management
+ Commercialization
+ Sustaining engineering

* Ensure platform designs meet performance, reliability, scalability, maintainability, and security requirements.
* Establish architecture documentation, reference implementations, coding standards, and platform adoption guidelines.

Agentic AI Enablement
  
  

* Architect frameworks enabling AI agents to interact with embedded systems, sensors, edge-AI services, and device resources.
* Define SDK interfaces for model execution, orchestration engines, memory systems, telemetry, context management, and tool invocation.
* Design software abstractions supporting on-device AI workloads across constrained embedded environments.
* Collaborate with AI framework teams to enable deployment of agentic and generative AI capabilities on Qualcomm platforms.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with silicon architects, systems teams, operating system teams, AI researchers, security architects, and developer tooling organizations.
* Influence future chipset software roadmaps through architecture proposals and technical leadership.
* Mentor software engineers and contribute to technical growth across the organization.
* Represent Qualcomm with OEMs, ecosystem partners, standards bodies, and open-source communities when required.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

OR
  
  
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
  
  
OR
  
  
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

title: Technical Lead
description:
**Job Summary – AI Technical Lead.**

* Kumaran Systems is looking for an experienced
  **AI**
  **Lead (Technical)**
  to lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable, production-ready AI/ML solutions within its
  **Equity Market Technology -Capital Markets domain.**

* The role will drive innovation in
  **Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI workflows, and intelligent automation using the Microsoft Azure cloud platform**
  .

* The candidate will
  **provide technical leadership to a team of AI engineers**
  , collaborate closely with stakeholders, data scientists, and platform teams, and translate business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable AI solutions.

* The role requires strong hands-on
  **technical expertise, solution architecture capabilities, and the ability to lead AI initiatives from Concept to Production.**

**Details of Employment:**

**Location:**
Chennai, India

**Work Location**
– Guindy Olympia Tech Park OR SIPCOT Siruseri.

**Mode of Employment**
- 3 days Hybrid in the Office.

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time, Permanent.

**Notice Period**
- 0 to 15 days from the date of the offer (
**Critical Requisition; hence the ask**
)

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI Architecture and Solution Design**

* Architect and lead the development of enterprise-grade RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, vector databases, embedding models, and retrieval strategies using Azure AI Search, FAISS, and Pinecone.
* Design and implement Agentic AI systems incorporating autonomous agents, multi-step planning, tool orchestration, reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Develop AI solutions that integrate with internal systems, including trading platforms, operations workbenches, and risk engines, to automate decision support, exception handling, and reporting.
* Establish standards for prompt engineering, AI guardrails, and evaluation frameworks, including offline evaluations, A/B testing, and automated regression testing.

**2. Azure Cloud and AI Platform Engineering**

* Lead the design, implementation, and management of AI/ML infrastructure on Microsoft Azure using Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Design scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient AI inference pipelines using caching, request batching, and token-budget optimization.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML models and AI agents, incorporating model versioning, controlled deployments, A/B testing, rollback mechanisms, and observability.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise cloud governance, data residency, and security requirements using Azure Private Endpoints, Managed Identity, Key Vault, and related security controls.

**3. AI Performance Optimization and Troubleshooting**

* Diagnose and resolve production AI performance issues, including inference latency, embedding drift, retrieval quality degradation, hallucinations, and context-window limitations.
* Monitor and optimize token consumption, API rate limits, throughput, and cost per query across production AI workloads.
* Establish AI observability through structured logging, distributed tracing across prompt processing, retrieval, and generation, and dashboards tracking latency (p50/p95/p99), retrieval recall, and answer relevance.
* Conduct root-cause analysis of AI system failures, including incorrect tool invocations, RAG retrieval failures, safety-filter false positives, and model regressions following version upgrades.

**4. Technical Leadership and Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of 4–6 AI/ML engineers, overseeing code reviews, architecture decisions, sprint planning, engineering standards, and professional development.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, data scientists, quantitative teams, and operations leaders to translate business requirements into scalable, production-ready AI solutions.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, model releases, fine-tuning techniques, agent frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, and CrewAI, and AI evaluation methodologies.
* Represent the AI engineering function in technical design reviews, architecture governance forums, and incident post-mortems.
* Drive engineering best practices and continuous improvement across AI solution design, development, deployment, monitoring, security, and operational support.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on AI/ML solutions in production environments.
* Deep hands-on experience with RAG architectures, including vector databases, embedding pipelines, chunking strategies, hybrid search (keyword + semantic), re-ranking, and retrieval evaluation.
* Proven track record of building Agentic AI systems, including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, planning loops, memory management, and fallback strategies.
* Strong proficiency in Azure Cloud services, including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search (formerly Cognitive Search), Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, AKS, and App Service.
* Experience troubleshooting AI performance issues, including inference latency optimization, token budgeting, embedding drift detection, hallucination mitigation, and cost management at scale.
* Proficiency in Python and at least one of the following: C#/.NET or TypeScript/Node.js.
* Experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or CrewAI.
* Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, including transformers, attention mechanisms, fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), RLHF, and evaluation metrics such as BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, faithfulness, and relevance.
* Experience leading engineering teams of 4+ members in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and prepare clear technical documentation.

Resumes can be shared with
**devika.raju@kumaran.com**

title: Solutions Architect
description:
About the role

You will be the architect who wins the technical deal. Before a contract is signed, you show enterprise customers that their AI agents will work, at their scale and under their rules. You build the demos and proofs of concept, answer the architecture questions, and hand delivery a plan they can execute. This is a hands-on engineering role in front of customers. You write code most weeks and spend the rest with CIOs, platform teams and risk officers. You report to the Co-Founder and CTO.

What you will do

• Discover: run technical discovery with CIOs, platform-engineering and risk teams at banks, insurers and asset managers. Map their systems, data and controls to the agent use cases that matter.

• Demo: build tailored demos of agent workflows, using the customer's own scenarios where you can.

• Prove: scope and deliver 2 to 6 week proofs of concept. Write the code, wire up integrations and measure results against agreed success criteria.

• Design: produce reference architectures for agent deployment on AWS, Azure or GCP, covering identity, data access, observability and guardrails.

• De-risk: answer security, compliance and model-risk questionnaires (SOC 2, data residency, audit logging, human-in-the-loop controls).

• Hand off: turn every won proof of concept into a delivery plan our forward-deployed engineers can run from day one.

• Feed back: bring field patterns to product and build reusable demo assets, templates and starter agents.

What we are looking for

• 8+ years in software engineering, solutions engineering, solutions architecture or forward-deployed engineering for enterprise customers.

• Hands-on experience building LLM applications or agents: prompt and tool design, RAG, evaluation, and at least one agent framework.

• Strong Python, plus working knowledge of APIs, containers and one major cloud.

• Comfort in regulated environments, where governance, auditability and access control decide the deal.

• Consulting experience: client-facing work, scoping engagements and running workshops with enterprise stakeholders.

• Understanding of tool calling and MCP, guardrails and policy controls, access management, observability and audit trails.

Nice to have

• Experience selling to, or working inside, financial services.

• Kubernetes, observability or AIOps tooling.

• AWS, Azure or GCP certifications.

• A public demo, repo, talk or post about something you built with agents.

Location: Chennai, India (Chennai office), hybrid 3 days on-site, with travel to customer sites as needed.
