Moring helps enterprises put AI agents into production safely.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
As a Software Engineering Manager within MS TECH Order Fulfillment, you will provide strategic product and technical leadership, along with hands-on expertise, to build industry-leading products. You are a systems thinker capable of driving large-scale transformations that maximize value for Ford, our Dealers, and our customers. The role combines high-level strategy, including product vision, AI/ML use-case portfolio, data strategy, and technical roadmaps, with disciplined execution to deliver scalable, resilient, secure, explainable, and highly available solutions in a global environment.
  
  
**Technical Leadership & Vision**

* Serve as the primary technical authority for the Order Generation product suite, defining the evolution of the technology stack, data architecture, AI/ML capabilities, and architectural patterns.
* Lead cross-functional teams through complex integrations, managing dependencies across the broader Order Fulfillment ecosystem to ensure seamless data flow and system interoperability.
* Translate high-level business requirements into actionable technical strategies that align with Ford enterprise standards.

**AI/ML Product Strategy & Innovation**

* Define and execute an AI/ML and data analytics product strategy that converts priority business requirements into a sequenced portfolio of intelligent capabilities and measurable outcomes.
* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI/ML opportunities across forecasting, order generation, decision support, anomaly detection, optimization, and workflow automation using value, feasibility, risk, data readiness, and adoption criteria.
* Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of AI/ML products from discovery, business-case development, experimentation, and MVP validation through industrialization, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, Product, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Legal, Privacy, and business teams to ensure solutions are technically sound, usable, compliant, and aligned with responsible AI principles.
* Establish outcome-based product metrics, experimentation methods, model performance targets, and adoption measures; use evidence and customer feedback to guide investment and roadmap decisions.
* Monitor emerging technologies, including generative AI, agentic AI, foundation models, advanced analytics, optimization, and intelligent automation, and determine where they can create differentiated business value.
* Drive build, buy, or partner assessments and develop scalable patterns for reusable AI/ML services, data products, model APIs, and decision intelligence capabilities.

**Product Strategy & Delivery**

* Partner with business stakeholders to define and execute a multi-year product vision and roadmap focused on optimized order forecasting and generation.
* Champion an iterative, Agile delivery model, prioritizing the delivery of Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) and maintaining a high-velocity release cadence.
* Apply Human-Centered Design (HCD) principles to ensure technical solutions solve real-world problems for Dealers and customers.
* Create launch and adoption plans that include operational readiness, user training, change management, benefit tracking, and feedback loops.

**Data, Model & MLOps Excellence**

* Ensure AI/ML solutions are supported by trusted, governed, discoverable, and fit-for-purpose data, with clear ownership, lineage, quality controls, and access patterns.
* Guide the implementation of robust MLOps and LLMOps practices covering reproducible experimentation, model registry, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, rollback, and auditability.
* Define controls for model quality, explainability, bias and fairness evaluation, privacy, security, human oversight, and responsible use throughout the product lifecycle.
* Balance predictive accuracy with interpretability, latency, cost, reliability, and business usability when selecting models and architectures.

**Engineering & Operational Excellence**

* Enforce rigorous engineering standards, including Test-Driven Development (TDD), robust CI/CD pipelines, and DevSecOps practices.
* Drive a culture of Full Lifecycle Ownership, where the team is responsible for the design, security, deployment, and operational health of its services.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for system health, code quality, delivery velocity, model performance, data quality, adoption, and realized business value.

**Architectural Design**

* Architect and oversee the development of cloud-native, microservices-based systems designed for global scale, multi-tenancy, and high-performance transactional processing.
* Design interoperable data and AI architectures that support batch and real-time inference, event-driven workflows, APIs, observability, and secure integration with enterprise platforms.

**People Leadership & Talent Development**

* Cultivate a high-performing, diverse team of Software Engineers, Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and ML Engineers through active coaching, mentorship, and career pathing.
* Foster a culture of psychological safety and continuous learning, utilizing blameless retrospectives and regular feedback loops to drive team growth.
* Identify and close skill gaps within the team to keep pace with emerging technologies and industry trends.

**Strategic Collaboration**

* Act as a bridge between the product team and domain experts in Cloud Infrastructure, Data & AI, Cybersecurity, Responsible AI, SRE, and DevOps to reduce portfolio complexity.

**Technical Execution (Hands-on)**

title: Associate Senior Solutions Architect - req38675
description:
**Associate Senior Solutions Architect**
Job #: req38675
  
  
Organization: World Bank
  
  
Sector: Information Technology
  
  
Grade: GG
  
  
Term Duration: Open-Ended Staff (OPEN-OP)
  
  
Recruitment Type: Local Recruitment
  
  
Location: Chennai,India
  
  
Required Language(s): English
  
  
**Preferred Language(s)**
Closing Date: 10/30/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC
  
  
**Description**
At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd
  
  
**ITS Vice Presidency Context**
The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150+ locations. For more information on ITS, see this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload=9&v=VTFGffa1Y7w
  
  
**Department Context**
The ITS Operations Products unit (ITSOP) enables the Bank's operational business processes through modern, flexible and user-friendly digital products. Its portfolio includes Operations Workspace and related solutions that bring together operational data, documents, workflows, collaboration and decision support for front-line staff.
  
  
ITSOP is seeking an Associate Senior Solutions Architect to provide hands-on architecture and engineering leadership for the Operations Workspace ecosystem. The successful candidate will combine deep Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse expertise with strong .NET and Azure engineering skills, personally implement prototypes and reference solutions, and guide delivery teams from design through production. The role will also help integrate Generative AI and agentic capabilities into operational workflows using a governed AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC). This is not a purely advisory role.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect translates complex operational requirements into secure, scalable and maintainable solutions across Dynamics 365, Dataverse, .NET, Azure, APIs, data platforms and AI services. The role defines architecture, validates choices through working code, establishes reusable patterns and guardrails, and remains directly engaged in troubleshooting, CI/CD, release readiness and production improvement.
  
  
**Duties And Accountabilities**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect works across multiple projects in the World Bank Operations portfolio and is accountable for ensuring that technical solutions are successfully designed, delivered and operated for Operations staff.
  
  
From a work-program perspective, the role provides technical leadership, delivery oversight and practical guidance to internal staff and globally distributed vendor teams. The architect helps sequence technical work, resolves delivery constraints and ensures that implementation remains aligned with business priorities, enterprise standards and release commitments.
  
  
From a technical perspective, the role leads application, integration and data architecture; identifies solution components and reusable patterns; validates designs through working prototypes; performs quality and code reviews; and remains accountable for delivery at speed, scale and quality.
  
  
**Role Scope and Distinction**

* Acts as a senior technical subject matter expert for complex, business-critical solutions in the Operations Workspace portfolio.
* Balances strategic architecture with recent, demonstrable hands-on contribution to prototypes, code, integration, deployment and technical problem-solving.
* Leads cross-layer design decisions involving applications, workflows, data, APIs, identity, security, observability and AI-enabled experiences.
* Guides multidisciplinary teams and vendors, mentors architects and engineers, and raises engineering quality through practical standards and reusable implementation assets.
* Works across globally distributed business, product, architecture, security, data, platform and engineering stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture for Operations Workspace and related products, aligning business outcomes, enterprise principles, security requirements and delivery constraints.
* Define target-state and transition architectures, solution options, architecture decision records, integration contracts, non-functional requirements and implementation roadmaps.
* Review designs and code for scalability, resilience, maintainability, interoperability, usability, performance and cost effectiveness.
* Identify systemic risks and technical debt, propose pragmatic remediation, and guide Agile Release Train and product teams through implementation trade-offs.

Lead solution delivery teams through implementation, maintenance, release readiness and operational improvement of business-critical applications supporting Operations Workspace and related Operations product ecosystems.
  
  
Lead application and data architecture modelling, component identification and solution quality reviews, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles and approved technology standards.
  
  
**Dynamics 365 and Dataverse Engineering**

* Architect and implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse solutions, including data models, security roles, business rules, workflows, plug-ins, custom actions, Power Platform components and environment strategy.
* Design supported extension patterns using C#/.NET, the Dataverse SDK and APIs while minimizing fragile customization and preserving upgradeability.
* Guide integration of Dynamics 365 with SharePoint Online, Microsoft Graph, Azure services, enterprise data products and other operational systems.
* Define application lifecycle management practices for solutions, configuration, environment variables, connection references, test data and controlled promotion across environments.

**Hands-on Prototyping and .NET Engineering**

* Personally design, code, test and demonstrate proofs of concept, technical spikes, reference implementations and minimum viable solutions.
* Develop secure APIs, services, plug-ins and integration components using C#, modern .NET, ASP.NET Core and RESTful patterns.
* Validate architecture choices through executable prototypes, performance tests and failure-mode testing before major delivery investment.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across user experience, application, integration, identity, data and infrastructure layers, and support teams during critical releases.

**Integration, Cloud and Platform Architecture**

* Design API-led, event-driven and workflow-based integrations using appropriate Azure services, API management, messaging, serverless and container patterns.
* Apply identity-first design using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, least privilege, secrets management and auditable authorization patterns, including B2E and approved external-access scenarios.
* Define observability using structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, dashboards and actionable alerts across application and integration components.
* Collaborate with data and platform teams to connect operational applications to governed data services, analytics products and structured and unstructured enterprise information.

Design integrations with institutional systems and data platforms, including financing, trust funds, board operations, budgeting, SAP and enterprise data services, using supported APIs, events and workflow patterns.
  
  
Architect document and content-management integrations across Dynamics 365, SharePoint Online and approved cloud services, including secure storage, metadata, retrieval and downstream AI processing.
  
  
**Agentic AI and AI-enabled Operations**

* Design and prototype AI-enabled features and agentic workflows embedded in Operations Workspace, with explicit task boundaries, approved tools, controlled permissions, human review and failure handling.
* Integrate agents with Dynamics 365, enterprise APIs, documents, data platforms and business workflows using secure tool calling, structured outputs and reusable orchestration patterns.
* Apply retrieval-augmented generation, document intelligence and knowledge-grounding approaches where they improve operational workflows and decision support.
* Define evaluation, telemetry and guardrails for groundedness, task success, safety, latency, reliability and cost, and ensure Responsible AI, privacy, records and security requirements are addressed.

Partner with information security teams on architecture reviews, threat modelling, control implementation, security testing and remediation evidence required for production approval.
  
  
**Delivery Lifecycle, CI/CD and Engineering Excellence**

* Establish and improve CI/CD pipelines for Dynamics 365 solutions, .NET services, infrastructure configuration and AI components using Azure DevOps or equivalent enterprise tooling.
* Embed automated unit, integration, contract, security, regression and performance testing into delivery pipelines, with quality gates, approvals, release evidence and rollback approaches.
* Apply both the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and a governed AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC), covering use-case framing, data and grounding readiness, prompt and tool versioning, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and change control.
* Create reusable templates, starter repositories, SDKs, reference pipelines, coding standards and implementation guidance that improve developer productivity and consistency.

**Stakeholder, Vendor and Team Leadership**

* Translate operational needs into feasible technical choices and communicate architecture decisions and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Provide practical technical direction to internal teams and vendors, review deliverables against agreed architecture and quality expectations, and intervene hands-on where necessary.
* Mentor architects and engineers through pairing, design reviews, code reviews, demonstrations and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Partner with product leadership to sequence enablers, reduce delivery risk and ensure technical work results in measurable operational value.

Provide work-program oversight for internal and vendor delivery teams across locations, assess deliverable quality, remove technical blockers and hold suppliers accountable for agreed architecture, engineering and documentation standards.
  
  
Selection Criteria
  
  

* Master's degree with at least eight years of relevant experience, or bachelor's degree with at least ten years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, in computer science, software engineering, information systems or a related field.
* Substantial recent experience architecting and delivering large-scale enterprise applications using Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dataverse, .NET and Azure.
* Demonstrated hands-on contribution to production solutions, including personal coding, prototyping, integration, troubleshooting and deployment responsibilities.
* Experience leading complex delivery across internal staff, vendors and globally distributed teams in environments with strong governance, security and operational requirements.
* At least seven years of experience developing and maintaining large-scale solutions using C# and the Microsoft .NET ecosystem.
* At least five years of experience architecting Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Dataverse solutions and integrations with SharePoint Online, Azure services and enterprise or on-premises systems.
* Proven experience leading large, complex technical deliverables and globally distributed development teams, including vendor or offshore delivery, in environments with shifting priorities and multi-layered governance.

**Required Technical Capabilities**

* Advanced Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse architecture, including data modelling, security, workflows, plug-ins, custom APIs, Power Platform extensibility and solution ALM.
* Advanced C# and modern .NET engineering, including ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, automated testing and secure coding.
* Strong Azure application architecture experience, including App Service, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, Application Insights, storage and container-based deployment patterns.
* Strong systems integration capability across APIs, events, enterprise applications, Microsoft 365 services, SharePoint Online and data platforms.
* Hands-on CI/CD and DevSecOps experience, including source control, branching, build and release pipelines, infrastructure/configuration automation, quality gates, secrets handling and rollback.
* Practical experience designing or implementing Generative AI and agentic capabilities, including tool calling, orchestration, retrieval, structured outputs, evaluation, observability and human oversight.
* Ability to apply SDLC and ADLC controls to move prototypes into secure, supportable and production-ready services.
* Strong security architecture knowledge covering identity, authorization, least privilege, data protection, auditability, threat modelling and secure integration.
* Ability to produce clear architecture documentation and to explain decisions, alternatives, risks and trade-offs to varied audiences.
* Hands-on experience extending Dynamics 365 using C#/.NET plug-ins, custom APIs, workflows and supported client-side technologies, with strong knowledge of Dataverse security, data modelling and reporting capabilities.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID, including B2E and approved B2B scenarios.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Operations Workspace, operational process platforms, project or portfolio management solutions, or comparable enterprise CRM/workflow ecosystems.
* Experience with Angular or React and modern web application integration with .NET and Dynamics 365 back ends.
* Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel or comparable enterprise agent frameworks.
* Experience with document intelligence, enterprise search, RAG, semantic layers, knowledge graphs or governed access to structured and unstructured information.
* Experience with SAFe, Agile Release Trains, product operating models and architecture governance.
* Experience in international development, financial services or another regulated environment with strong privacy, security and audit requirements.
* Relevant Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, DevOps, security or architecture certifications.
* Working knowledge of enterprise data and analytics platforms, including data lakes, data warehouses, Power BI, Azure Data Factory, Databricks or comparable integration and analytics services.

**Recommended Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert or relevant Dynamics 365 certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert.
* SAFe for Architects (ARCH) and/or SAFe DevOps (SDP).
* Relevant Microsoft applied skills or certifications in Azure AI, Azure OpenAI or Copilot Studio.

As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:
  
  

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.
* Bring experience working in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent (FCV) contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.

**WBG Culture Attributes**

* Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.
* Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
* Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.

Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  
  
Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  
  
Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

**Engineer, Platform Services Architecture 1**
**Role Description Summary**
As a leading contributor, this position will perform services design requirement analysis, development of product-specific architectures, lab testing and evaluation, prototype demonstration, and technical documentation across Network Engineering. You will drive best practice development by providing consistent design methodology and modelling for asset management, provisioning standards, fault management analysis, utilization and performance monitoring, and security requirements. In conjunction with design development, this role will interact with SES upstream and downstream teams to define detailed Statement of Work (SOW) documentation. We are looking for a strategic expert that is familiar with the integration of existing and emerging technology trends and can provide advanced technical leadership for continued growth. In collaboration with other senior SME’s, this position will mentor junior team members and assist in the creation of a training environment for the Deployment and Operations teams. In addition, you will provide level 4 services support to the Operations team.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities / Key Result Areas**

* Provide guidance on all existing and proposed architecture to ensure that the design supports strong performance and that proper monitoring/analytic tools are in place.
* Provide level 4 operational support to the level 1 and 2 NOCs for trouble ticket escalations
* Support the rest of the platform engineering team with hub hardware deployments and assist operations with service activations.
* Ensure that all designs apply consistent methodology with best practices, in order to deliver stable and secure networks.
* Perform engineering calculation related to design that requires the application of standard engineering principles, theories, concepts and techniques.
* Provide SME (Subject Matter Expert) support for service feasibility.
* Create detailed scope requirements for the Statement of Work (SOW) process, ensuring that final documentation is clear and accurate to ensure the greatest work efficiency.
* Collaborate with Project Managers to ensure the success of the design detailed in the SOW, including communication regarding technical scope, schedule, budget, and resource needs.
* Work closely with Finance, Engineering, and other applicable departments to ensure the profitability of all designs.
* Practice and enforce compliance with current operating standards, to best assess effectiveness and process alignment.
* Provide proactive leadership to mentor and coach all team members.
* Enhance training materials and deliver ongoing training to Operations team members.

COMPETENCIES
  
  

* Ability to demonstrate technical leadership focusing on system integrity throughout the system lifecycle
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication skills, both written, and oral
* Ability to work and deliver within a fast-paced working environment
* Ability to set priorities and work under deadlines
* Good teamwork spirit by working cohesively with the team towards a common goal

**Qualifications & Experience**

* A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or similar discipline with at least five years of network and/or systems experience (or an equivalent amount of education and work experience).
* Must have Expert-level knowledge of Satellite Broadband systems like the following: iDirect Products (Evolution, Velocity, and Dialog), Gilat SkyEdgeIIc and SkyEdgeIV, and Comtech Heights, and the Hughesnet Jupiter 3 platforms.
* Must have Expert-level knowledge of system hub components and VSAT Terminals and VSAT Antennas
* Must have knowledge and experience with deploying global VSAT networks and hub systems
* Must have Experience in L3 and L4 NOC support
* Knowledge of various modulation and coding schemes for DVB-S, DVB-S2, and DVB-S2X.
* Must have knowledge of IP routing protocols, including but not limited to: BGP, OSPF, RIP-2 and ISIS.
* Must have knowledge of switching technologies including but not limited to; IGMP, 802.XX, Gigabit Ethernet, 10G Ethernet, Vlan/Trunking (802.1q And ISL), Etherchannel, Spanning Tree (STP), EVPN and VXLAN.
* Have knowledge of ancillary technologies used to support telecommunication network such as management and metric gathering tools (Rest-API, SNMP, Netflow), packet capturing tools, and automation tools.
* Ability to analyze complex situations and utilize creative problem-solving abilities
* Knowledge of operating systems, including Linux, Debian, Unix, and related OS.
* Must be able and willing to travel domestically and internationally up to 25%.
* Must be able and willing to perform physical support activities (e.g. cable tracing/running and racking, stacking, replacing and installing hardware) as needed.

title: Staff/Senior Operations Engineer
description:
**Job Type**
Full-time
  
  
**Description**
**About CloudBees:**
CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.
  
  
Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.
  
  
CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.
  
  
Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
  
  
Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.
  
  
**About the Role:**
To support the delivery of CloudBees products (both internal and external), our Operations team designs, deploys, secures and manages a variety of software systems and the related GCP / AWS infrastructure that underpins these software engineering objectives. Our guiding principle is simple - “Make Engineering Faster”. Underpinning this are the challenges of security, process change, technical change that all must be met to varying degrees. Further, we are passionate about reducing the manual work that plagues IT teams - Engineering / Ops / Support / Security - and are empowered to re-engineer processes and technology to achieve those objectives.
  
  
We are looking for someone who:
  
  

* Is able to troubleshoot complex issues calmly.
* An open communicator, capable of bringing new ideas to the team
* Is able to learn from colleagues at all levels
* Understands, and is motivated by, rapidly changing technologies and has demonstrable competence with modern AI tools.

You are:
  
  

* self-motivated and enjoy solving problems
* excited by the opportunity to automate yourself out of recurring workable to self-organize and document your work and decisions effectively
* You will liaise directly with the software engineers across all teams, ensuring that decisions are agreed internally and externally to Operations and that they meet our technical and non-technical objectives.

How you’ll work:
  
  

* In a geographically distributed team (APAC, US, EMEA) of peers
* Choose your own work in tandem with the team, team-leader, and manager
* Flexible working hours - while there will be some core hours required for meeting with Engineering and Operations teams - much latitude is given in getting work done.
* Hybrid work based out of our Chennai hub

**Requirements**
**What you’ll Do:**
**Team-building**
- inside the team and across teams - you’ll be proposing new ideas and helping implement them
**Thinking**
- coming up with new ways of solving problems - and working with the team to prove them out and then implement them. Keeping up to speed with the latest technology, and proactively making use of tools like coding assistants and AI agents to accelerate your work.
**Documenting**
- describing problems, how your proposed solution solves those problems, and how your implemented solutions are operated.
**Optimizing**
- working with Engineering teams to optimize their build systems. Managing and developing tools which enable Engineers to ship faster.
**Defining**
- writing / modifying Terraform to handle our infrastructure, and helping teams define their infrastructure using our modules.
**Coding**
- you’ll be writing code in Golang - we occasionally write code in TypeScript, Python, and Groovy
**Securing**

* working with our security team to drive operational change in engineering teams
* working with our security team to drive organizational security changes (logging, auditing, monitoring, alerting)

**Observing**
- adding the right monitoring so that we are alerted before our customers notice, and not alerted when the system is able to heal itself
**Alerting**
- getting alerts and working with team members to solve the initial problem, documenting the problem and then working out how to stop them happening again
**DevOps / DevSecOps**
- We’re not “DevOps” engineers, but we do help our teams become more proficient in doing Dev and Ops (and embracing Total Ownership). We build the guard rails to help them do it safely and align tech-stacks across the company.
**What you will work on**
-
  
  

* IaaS - GCP, AWS
* AI tooling and automation - Claude Code, Codex, AWS Bedrock Agentcore, Software Factories
* Platform tools - Kubernetes, terraform, helm, docker
* Language tools - Golang
* Engineering tools - Jenkins, Backstage
* Operations tools - PagerDuty, DataDog

**Role Requirements:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or related field
* 8+ years working in a DevOps style environment - building automations, writing software, solving problems
* 2+ years working in AWS (preferred) or GCP
* 2+ years experience in a high level programming language (Golang / Python / Ruby / Java or similar)
* Experience of working asynchronously in a distributed team.
* Experience of contributing to your team’s technical strategy
* Strong self organization skills and communication skills

You have experience in:
  
  

* programming in various languages and domains
* Development with agentic AI and administration of tools
* the "modern Ops stack" (e.g. monitoring, alerting, cloud-based provisioning, Docker, Kubernetes)
* Linux systems administration
* cloud-based operations (GCP, AWS, or Azure)
* cluster orchestration and management tools (e.g. k8s / ECS / Terraform / etc)
* continuous integration / continuous delivery tools (Jenkins / Tekton etc)
* modern software engineering practices: code reviews, unit / acceptance testing, source control, etc.
* You have experience using work tools like GSuite, GitHub, Jira, Confluence, and Slack.
* Experience of managing and responding to production incidents

title: HCLS Solutions lead IRC302899
description:
**Description**
Join GlobalLogic’s Architects Team within the Healthcare Business Unit in India, supporting clients globally. This strategic role focuses on engaging new clients, solving real-world healthcare challenges, and launching data-driven AI/ML projects. You will work closely with clients and internal stakeholders to translate complex business needs into impactful data science solutions. If you’re passionate about applying data science in a meaningful domain and want to shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**Requirements**
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or related field.
  
  
15+ years of experience in MedTech/ Healthcare domain architecting and building platforms (SaMD, IOMT), well versed with EMR, EHR, DICOM, PACS, Clinical workflows
  
  
Experience in data science or machine learning roles, with exposure to healthcare projects.
  
  
Good expertise and skills using Claude/Codex or equivalent AI tools to do research, planning, software development and testing.
  
  
Proficiency in Python and/or any other programming language (C/C++, JAVA, C#, etc)
  
  
Strong communication and visualization skills for storytelling with data.
  
  
Experience building cloud solutions (Azure, AWS, or GCP – at least one strong) using native hyperscaler services.
  
  
Experience with LLM and GenAI constraints and limitations and how to overcome those.
  
  
English proficiency at Advanced level.
  
  
Good presentation and demonstration skills
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
Lead the design and development of solutions across HealthTech and MedTech projects.
  
  
Be comfortable with ambiguity, onsite/embedded work, have willingness to travel and work directly at the customer’s environment, building solutions under a hard deadline with incomplete requirements.
  
  
Participate in technical presales by analyzing business cases and identifying opportunities for AI/ML application.
  
  
Lead Discovery and/or Advisory projects, understand customer’s needs, collect inputs and pain points from the customer and create working SW prototypes within limited time to demonstrate feasibility & value.
  
  
Collaborate with software engineers, cloud architects, and QA to further develop prototypes into scalable production systems.
  
  
Contribute to the development of GlobalLogic’s healthcare-focused AI accelerators and reusable components.
  
  
Present technical solutions to clients, both business and technical audiences.
  
  
Ensure adherence to privacy, security, and compliance standards for data and AI usage.
  
  
Author clear documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Technical Architect - Associate Architect
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Product Architect
  
  
Consulting | Product Engineering / Cloud & AI
  
  
**About The Role**
The Product Architect is responsible for defining and governing the end-to-end architecture strategy across cloud, data, AI/ML, and application platforms within a product or offering portfolio. This is an 8-10 year role based in India / USI.
  
  
This role operates at the intersection of business strategy and engineering execution, translating client and product objectives into scalable, secure, and compliant target-state architectures. The Product Architect ensures alignment with Deloitte engineering standards, DevSecOps practices, and industry regulatory requirements while enabling high-quality, enterprise-grade delivery. The role requires deep technical expertise, strong stakeholder management, and the ability to influence across product, engineering, security, and client leadership teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Architecture Strategy & Governance
  
  

* Define and maintain target-state architecture for products and platforms across cloud, AI, data, and application layers
* Develop architecture roadmaps aligned to product vision, client requirements, and market strategy
* Establish and enforce architecture standards, reference architectures, and design principles
* Lead architecture review boards and document technical decision records
* Ensure alignment with Deloitte technology risk, security, and compliance frameworks

Cloud & Application Architecture
  
  

* Design secure cloud landing zones (IAM, network segmentation, logging, monitoring, cost controls)
* Architect multi-tenant and single-tenant SaaS platforms
* Define scalable microservices, API-first, and event-driven architectures
* Ensure non-functional requirements (scalability, resilience, performance, availability, DR) are embedded early in design
* Provide hands-on architectural guidance for cloud-native implementations (AWS/Azure/GCP)

AI/ML & Data Architecture
  
  

* Architect end-to-end AI/ML solutions from ingestion and feature engineering to model deployment and monitoring
* Define MLOps standards (model registry, CI/CD integration, reproducibility, drift detection)
* Establish data architecture standards including modeling, lineage, governance, access control, and retention
* Implement RBAC and fine-grained security models across data and application layers
* Ensure AI solutions comply with responsible AI, privacy, and regulatory expectations

DevSecOps & Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Drive DevSecOps adoption including IaC, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and secure release practices
* Embed security controls (SAST/DAST, secrets management) into the SDLC
* Promote SRE and observability practices across product teams
* Identify and mitigate architectural risks, technical debt, and systemic dependencies

Stakeholder & Team Leadership
  
  

* Partner with Product Owners, Engineering Leads, Security, and Client stakeholders to resolve architectural trade-offs
* Communicate complex technical concepts to executive audiences and delivery teams
* Mentor engineers and junior architects to elevate architectural maturity
* Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, and client solutioning as required
* Support capability development within the practice through knowledge sharing and reusable assets

Reporting Relationships
  
  
Reports to the Product Engineering Leader / Offering Architect. Partners with Product Owners, Engineering Leads, Security, and Client stakeholders to resolve architectural trade-offs, and mentors engineers and junior architects across the practice.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 8-10 years of experience in software engineering and/or architecture roles
* Demonstrated experience delivering production-grade cloud-native solutions
* Strong expertise in distributed systems and enterprise application design
* Hands-on experience operationalizing AI/ML solutions and implementing MLOps
* Experience with enterprise data architecture and governance frameworks
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across product and delivery teams
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent

**Preferred**

* Deployment experience with GCP VertexAI / AWS Bedrock
* Cloud Architect certifications (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Experience working in regulated environments (Healthcare, Financial Services, Government)
* Exposure to Zero Trust security models and enterprise compliance frameworks
* Experience contributing to reusable accelerators, frameworks, or IP

Core Competencies
  
  
Technical Excellence
  
  

* Cloud architecture (IAM, networking, compute, storage, observability)
* Application architecture (microservices, APIs, integration patterns)
* AI/ML architecture and MLOps
* Data governance and RBAC
* DevSecOps and infrastructure as code

Leadership & Impact
  
  

* Influence without authority
* Executive-level communication and storytelling
* Risk identification and mitigation
* Coaching and talent development
* Structured problem-solving and decision-making

Collaboration & Market Impact
  
  

* Cross-functional collaboration
* Client-facing architectural advisory
* Contribution to practice development and thought leadership

Why This Role Matters
  
  
Every product is only as strong as the architecture underneath it, and this role owns that foundation end-to-end. Success shows up as scalable, secure, production-ready architecture aligned to product and client strategy; reduced architectural risk and improved engineering quality; broad adoption of engineering standards and governance processes; and a growing library of Deloitte IP, accelerators, and reusable architecture assets that make every future product easier to build well.
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

This position is based out of Chennai, India. **Your Contribution:**
Move fast. Speak up. Decide and own. Drive change. Exceed customer needs. These are some of the winning behaviors you’ll need for success at Logitech.
  
  
In this role you will:
  
  

* Solution Design & CPQ Architecture: Lead the technical solutioning and architectural roadmap for Salesforce Sales Cloud and CPQ/Revenue Cloud to power the Logitech for Business roadmap. Architect end-to-end Quote-to-Cash solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise business goals.
* AI Integration & Automation: Business-minded technologist who is not just an expert in today's platform but is excited about building the future. The ideal candidate sees the potential for AI and automation to transform this space and is eager to lead that charge, evolving from a traditional developer/technical architect into a domain-anchored AI operator over the next three years.
* Platform Governance: Collaborate with the Platform team on establishing and enforcing design standards, best practices, and code review processes to ensure technical excellence and platform stability.
* Cross-Functional Strategy: Partner with Digital Offi ce teams and Security, Sales, and Marketing teams to translate business requirements into high-level technical designs. Act as the bridge between technical implementation and business value.
* Solution Delivery: Oversee comprehensive Sales & marketing solution delivery, including complex integrations (e.g., ERP, PRM, Marketing Automation), ensuring data consistency and smooth cutover while technical debt is well-managed.
* Technical Mentorship: Mentor junior developers and administrators, fostering growth and technical maturity across the CRM team.

**Key Qualifications:**
For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and behaviors to our team:
  
  

* For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and behaviors to our team:
* At least 10+ years experience working in the IT industry, with 7–10+ years of total Salesforce CRM experience
* 6+ years of experience designing complex, high transaction volume, enterprise-wide business solutions on the Salesforce Force.com platform using Apex, Visualforce and Lightning, including 5–8 years of dedicated CPQ experience
* 6+ years of experience with Salesforce.com's, support and service business processes with implementation experience in custom applications leveraging Salesforce Platform. Integration experience with other cloud based platforms and services, including any subscriptions system is a plus
* Solid understanding of best practices in CRM usage and ability to bring a consulting approach to help business solve issues and challenges
* Solid understanding of web technologies, such as HTTP, JavaScript, AJAX, HTML, DHTML, CSS and a strong understanding of Object-Oriented design and programming concepts
* Strong understanding of Salesforce Declarative, Programming and Administration (develop code, custom objects, Lightning components, Visualforce pages, Apex, reports, workfl ows, assignment rules, and more)
* Expertise in Sales Cloud, Quote-to-Cash and PRM business processes, with 3–5 years of Revenue Cloud / Multi-Cloud experience highly preferred.
* Knowledge of APEX triggers/SOQL queries and stored procedures
* Experience with Salesforce.com Web Services APIs
* Experience or Strong understanding of Salesforce Visualforce Sites and Communities
* Knowledge on Integration/Middleware tools such as Workato and MuleSoft
* Knowledge on integrated technologies Jira, Marketing Automation, Cloud Solutions is a plus
* Salesforce.com Platform Developer & Designer certifi cations In addition, preferable skills and behaviors include:
* Java Developer or SQL certification
* Work experience using standard HTML/CSS/Javascript practices
* Expertise in CRM Analytics, including working with recipes and data sets.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced setting and prioritize among competing tasks and assignments
* Must be a self-starter, with the ability to work independently without constant supervision and micromanagement
* Must be able to work fl exible hours to collaborate with Global IT and business team members
* Excellent analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Strong customer service mentality while being curious, methodical, rational, analytical, and logical.

**Small Company. Big Products.**
At Logitech we act like a small company. We believe that anyone can have the best idea. We are innovators, creators and designers. We challenge ourselves and each other, and believe that success is never final. We push the limit, because great is not good enough. We inspire, delight and empower the world. We are Logitech.
  
  
Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in-house.
  
  
Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate for the opportunity, we strongly recommend that you apply. We want to meet you!
  
  
We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. We can’t wait to tell you more about them being that there are too many to list here and they vary based on location.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, age, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.
  
  
If you require an accommodation to complete any part of the application process, are limited in the ability, are unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact us toll free at +1-510-713-4866 for assistance and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

****AI / ML Architect (Hands-On | Individual Contributor)****
****Experience****
**8-10 years total experience with 5+ years in AI / ML systems and strong hands-on coding skills.**
****Role Summary****
**We are looking for a hands-on AI / ML Architect who will work as an Individual Contributor, designing, building and deploying scalable AI / ML solutions. This role is NOT people-management focused – you will actively write production grade code, build models, architect ML platforms, and collaborate closely with cross functional engineering, product, and domain teams.**
****What You’ll Do:****
**We are currently seeking an experienced AI Architect who will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to develop and deploy AI-powered features and tools that optimize employee experiences and drive business outcomes.**

* As an AI/ML Arch, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying machine learning models and AI applications that solve complex business problems.
* Expert in Designing and developing search and chat applications that utilize Agentic AI.
* Design and develop AI paved paths for the Alight engineering organization.
* Experiment to evaluate application performance, including designing experiments to evaluate the performance of machine learning models, and then analyze and interpret the results to improve model performance.
* Stay up to date with new tools and technologies and evaluating their potential impact on the business.
* Work with stakeholders to develop and tune algorithms to address business needs. You should be able to effectively communicate your ideas in non-technical terms to help educate business partners
* Evaluate, fine‑tune, and deploy LLMs and foundation models; implement RAG, guardrails, and prompt engineering best practices (conversant with Github Copilot).
* Conversant with LLM security practices – Secure model deployment, Input validation, Data verification (guardrails) etc.
* Write production quality Python code for:

+ Feature Engineering
+ Model evaluation
+ Interface services (APIs)

* Conversant with Spring AI – building MCPs, tools, pre-plugin and post-plugin etc.
* Build high performant Ingestion pipelines.
* Expertise across cloud (AWS), data engineering, ML/GenAI and data ingestion techniques
* Work with CI/CD pipelines (Github Actions, Gitlab, Jenkins)
* Mentor engineers on ML best practices (without direct people management)
* Collaborate on a high-performing, agile team with a global presence

****What You’ll Need:****

* Overall, 8 -10 years of experience into Data Engineering, Ingestion, AI ML / Gen AI related projects.
* Specifically, AI / Gen AI / ML project(s) with 5+ years of experience
* Master’s degree with preferred concentrations in Computer Science, Data Science, Math, Actuarial Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Experience writing in Python or Spark (ScalaSpark or PySpark) and with popular machine learning libraries such as TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, and conversant with JAVA (Spring AI)

description:

Verizon is seeking a highly technical, hands-on Principal Security Engineer to join our Data as a Service (DaaS) & Analytics team. In this senior individual contributor role , you will act as the technical North Star for our analytics engineering teams, driving the cloud-native automation strategies required to expose critical enterprise security data via robust APIs and interactive dashboards. This is an execution-focused, "hands-on with code" position. You will architect and build modern data products, leveraging the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem to design scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and serverless application architectures.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**

* Architecting and optimizing large-scale security data repositories within Google BigQuery, ensuring efficient partitioning, clustering, and storage tiering to support multi-terabyte analytical queries.
* Designing and implementing robust, low-latency data pipelines using GCP Dataflow services (Apache Beam) to ingest, transform, and aggregate batch and streaming data from disparate security sources into centralized data platforms.
* Designing and maintaining optimized data layers using the GCP Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL engine) to support high-throughput analytics and data consumers.
* Leading analytics engineers technically to architect and deploy production-grade automation solutions. Utilize GCP Cloud Run and Cloud Functions to build scalable, event-driven microservices and high-performance APIs that expose enterprise security data.
* Identifying opportunities to integrate AI/ML automation (e.g., Vertex AI, LLMs) to streamline manual data extraction, automate metadata tagging, and optimize pipeline orchestration.
* Driving the transition from standard visualization to a scalable data product model, establishing a comprehensive Looker dashboard catalog to streamline enterprise risk forecasting.
* Developing and maintaining a standardized semantic layer using LookML (Looker Modeling Language) to ensure data consistency, security access controls, and reusability across all security domains.
* Building comprehensive business cases and data models surrounding Enterprise Security Data Analysis and Reporting to drive long-term security investments.

**What We’re Looking For...**

* Proven experience architecting and developing solutions within Google Cloud Platform, specifically leveraging containerized deployments via Cloud Run and serverless computing via Cloud Functions.
* Deep technical mastery of Google BigQuery architecture, including nested/repeated fields, materialized views, and BigQuery Omni or ML capabilities.
* Hands-on experience building streaming and batch data processing pipelines using GCP Dataflow services.
* Advanced proficiency in writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Strong hands-on coding expertise in Python to perform advanced data analysis, data mining, DevSecOps automation, and pipeline orchestration.
* Familiarity with deploying AI-driven automation workflows to improve data pipeline resilience.
* Experience utilizing visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Thoughtspot) to build data-driven stories tailored for business users at all levels.
* Experience embedding Looker visualizations directly into serverless applications or enterprise API frameworks is highly desirable.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor degree in Computer Science/Information Systems or six or more years of work experience.
* Eight or more years of professional experience in data analytics, business analysis or comparable analytics position.
* Advanced proficiency in Python and writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Ability to write SQL against a relational database in order to analyze and test data.
* Experience with modern DataOps/DevSecOps orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, CI/CD pipelines) applied directly to data engineering.
* Working knowledge on Threat, Risk and Vulnerability Management is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of securing cloud data delivery layers (OAuth, OIDC, API Gateways) and enforcing data privacy/governance standards.
* Cloud Certifications

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Experience in technology leadership, architecture, and Agile methodologies.
* Communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Problem solving skills to develop quick yet sound solutions to resolve complex issues.
* Experience in driving AI automation, delivering high performing and scalable applications.
* Experience with DevOps CI/CD processes to automate build and deployments.
* Experience mentoring and coaching diverse teams.
* Experience in identifying and analyzing and finding RCA for Errors and working with cross functional teams like SRE and backend team
* Experience with analytical tools and DBs like Postgres, Looker , ELK, ETL tools
* Recognizing, tracking, and communicating issues, accomplishments, milestones to the team and business partners.
* Professional Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect certification.
* Good presentation and communication skills.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40

The role combines hands-on identity architecture with technical leadership across cloud and on-premises environments. The successful candidate will drive secure identity architecture, privileged-access controls, identity hardening, and continuous improvement while providing technical direction on enterprise identity security.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect, implement, maintain, and continuously improve enterprise Active Directory environments, including multi-domain and multi-forest architectures.
* Establish secure Active Directory tiering, delegation, security baselines, and privileged-access models.

* Direct the architecture, configuration, security, and operational governance of Entra ID.

* Govern enterprise application onboarding, application registrations, external identities, user and group access, and identity lifecycle controls within Entra ID.
* Perform periodic Entra ID architecture and security assessments and recommend improvements based on identified risks and enterprise requirements.
* Lead privileged credential and access management through CyberArk, including credential vaulting, rotation, privileged-account onboarding, and break-glass account governance.
* Drive CyberArk privileged-access improvements that enforce controlled, time-limited, and least-privilege access patterns.
* Support investigation and remediation of identity-security incidents involving CyberArk, Entra ID, and Active Directory.
* Provide senior technical leadership and architectural guidance for identity-security initiatives involving CyberArk, Entra ID, and Active Directory.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, security, and application teams to deliver integrated and resilient enterprise identity solutions.
* Support audit and regulatory activities by providing appropriate identity-security evidence and driving remediation of identified control gaps.
* Contribute to executive-level reporting and recommendations concerning enterprise identity-security posture.

**Required Skills**
Proficient
  
  

* CyberArk
* Entra ID
* Active Directory

**Experience**

* 8+ years of cybersecurity experience, including 6+ years specifically in identity and access management.
* Experience in architecting and operating enterprise Active Directory and hybrid identity environments.
* Experince in working with Entra ID and cloud-based identity environments.
* Experince in designing and managing privileged-access solutions.
* Demonstrated experience operating identity services in complex enterprise environments.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**About The Role**
**About Soar and how we build :**
Soar is building an AI-native home-financing platform for Saudi Arabia, and the AI-driven engineering system that builds it. Our product spans origination, credit decisioning, loan management, collections and investor products, all under SAMA regulation.
  
We build differently. Our engineers don't hand-write code; they specify, direct and review AI agents that do. If that sounds like where engineering is going, you'll fit here.
  
How we work :
  
Agents write the code. Engineers own the spec, the context, the tests and the review. DevOps doesn't hand-manage servers either.
  
Context engineering is the core skill. Agents work from a shared knowledge graph of business rules, architecture principles and money-movement rules that we keep current.
  
We build our own agents. Requirements, DevOps, PM and self-testing agents run on our MCP/A2A framework to automate the SDLC end to end.
  
Full stack by default. AI closes skill gaps, so engineers work across backend, frontend and infrastructure, with cross-domain reviewers.
  
Regulated means rigorous. Money-movement logic gets human review, every time. KSA data residency shapes which models and tools we use and where they run.
  
What every role here needs: you already use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) as your main way of working, not as autocomplete. You can show us real workflows you've built, where they broke, and what you changed.
  
**Role Summary:**
We rely heavily on AI to build, test, and improve software. We are looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager who can lead a team of engineers working with AI agents, keep delivery focused, and ensure every release meets a high quality bar. You will combine people leadership with practical technical oversight and help your team become more effective every week.
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the team’s delivery from requirements through production, with clear scope, acceptance criteria, priorities, and accountability.
* Coach engineers to use AI agents effectively for implementation, debugging, refactoring, testing, and documentation; contribute directly when needed.
* Help the team break complex work into reviewable tasks, provide relevant context to agents, and validate results against product requirements.
* Review designs and critical code changes, challenge unsupported AI assumptions, and ensure changes remain understandable and maintainable.
* Embed automated tests, peer review, CI checks, security checks, and end-to-end validation into delivery; keep human review accountable for release decisions.
* Partner with Product, QA, and DevOps to resolve blockers, prepare releases, and address production issues and recurring defects.
* Run regular one-to-ones, give actionable feedback, support career growth, and manage workloads sustainably.
* Improve team practices using evidence from delivery lead time, escaped defects, reliability, and AI usage costs.

**Requirements**
**Requirements:**

* Typically 7+ years in software engineering and 2+ years leading engineers or managing a team; equivalent demonstrated impact is welcome.
* Strong hands-on experience building production applications, with sound knowledge of APIs, databases, testing, CI/CD, and cloud systems.
* Practical experience using AI coding assistants or agents to deliver production software and helping other engineers adopt them effectively.
* Ability to review and debug AI-generated code, identify missing edge cases, and select appropriate automated and human validation.
* Strong planning, communication, and coaching skills, with a record of creating clarity and delivering through a team.

**Nice to have :**
Experience building reusable agent workflows, integrating engineering tools through APIs or MCP, or delivering software in fintech or another regulated environment.
  
**What success looks like :**
The team ships tested features predictably, resolves issues quickly, and demonstrates improving quality and productivity. Engineers use AI effectively while understanding and owning the systems they deliver.

title: AI Architect
description:
**AI Architect – Core Agentic AI**

Experience: 10–14 years total; 4+ years in ML/AI, including 2+ years building LLM and agentic systems in production

Function: Core AI Platform / Agentic AI CoE

Reports to: Head of AI / Chief Architect

Location: [Chennai / Bangalore] – Hybrid

Employment: Full-time

**Role summary**

The AI Architect owns the end-to-end technical architecture of our agentic AI platform: how agents reason, plan, call tools, remember, and stay safe at enterprise scale. You set the reference architecture, patterns and guardrails that every AI product team builds on, and you are the final technical authority on agent design choices.

**Key responsibilities**

**Architecture and design**

* Define the reference
  **architecture for single- and multi-agent systems**
  : orchestration, planning, tool use, memory, state, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* Choose and justify agent patterns (ReAct, plan-and-execute, supervisor/worker, graph-based workflows) for each use case.
* Design the tool and integration layer, including
  **Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers**
  , function-calling contracts and enterprise API access.
* Architect retrieval and memory: RAG pipelines, hybrid search, vector and graph stores, short- and long-term agent memory.
* Set the model strategy: frontier API models vs. open-weight models, routing, fallbacks, fine-tuning vs. prompting, and cost/latency trade-offs.

**Platform, scale and reliability**

* Design for production: latency budgets, concurrency, caching, token cost controls, and graceful degradation.
* Define the LLMOps/AgentOps stack: tracing, evaluation, prompt and model versioning, observability and rollback.
* Establish evaluation frameworks covering task success, tool-call accuracy, hallucination rate, safety, and regression testing.

**Governance, security and Responsible AI**

* Build guardrails against prompt injection, data leakage, unsafe tool actions and over-permissioned agents.
* Define identity, authorization and audit for agents acting on behalf of users.
* Align designs with data privacy and AI regulation (e.g. DPDP Act, GDPR, EU AI Act where relevant) and internal Responsible AI policy.

**Leadership and influence**

* Run architecture reviews and write design docs, ADRs and reference implementations.
* Translate business problems into agentic solutions with clear ROI with product and business stakeholders.
* Evaluate emerging frameworks, models and vendors, and decide build vs. buy.
* Mentor senior engineers and grow architecture capability across teams.

**Must-have qualifications**

* 10–14 years in software engineering/architecture, with
  **4+ years in ML/AI and 2+ years shipping LLM-based or agentic systems to production.**
* Deep hands-on knowledge of LLM application design: prompting, function/tool calling, structured outputs, context management, RAG.
* Working experience with agent frameworks such as
  **LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex,**
  CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK or Claude Agent SDK.
* Experience with major
  **LLM providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock)**
  and open-weight models (Llama, Mistral, Qwen).
* Strong distributed-systems background: microservices, event-driven design, APIs, queues, async workflows.
* **Vector databases and search**
  : Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.
* Cloud architecture on at least one of AWS, Azure or GCP, with Kubernetes and containerisation.
* Strong
  **Python,**
  working knowledge of Java, TypeScript or Go.
* Proven record of owning architecture decisions with measurable business outcomes.

**Good to have**

* MCP server design and agent-to-agent (A2A) protocols.
* Fine-tuning and alignment techniques: LoRA/QLoRA, SFT, DPO; model serving with vLLM, TGI or Triton.
* Knowledge graphs and GraphRAG.
* Observability tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, Weights & Biases.
* Cloud architect certification (AWS / Azure / GCP); publications, patents or open-source contributions in AI.
* Domain exposure to BFSI, healthcare, retail, manufacturing or supply chain.

**Education**

B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech/MS in Computer Science, AI, Data Science or a related field. PhD a plus, not required.

**Success in the first 12 months**

* A published agentic reference architecture adopted by all AI product teams.
* 3+ agentic use cases moved from pilot to production with defined SLAs and evaluation gates.
* A guardrail and evaluation framework in place, with measurable drops in hallucination and unsafe-action rates.
* Clear reduction in LLM cost per transaction through routing, caching and model selection.
