title: Solution Architect
description:
**Role** 
 : Solution Architect (Python · Cloud\-Native Platforms)
 



**Experience** 
 level required: 10\-16 years
 



**Location** 
 : Chennai, Tamil Nadu/Hybrid
 



**Joining** 
 : Immediate to max 15 days
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Architecture ownership — produce and maintain solution blueprints, HLD documents, and Architecture Decision Records for every significant choice.
* Microservices \& event\-driven design — define service boundaries, inter\-service communication, idempotency, retries, dead\-letter handling, and backpressure using Kafka, Pub/Sub, and EventArc.
* API architecture — design and govern REST APIs, including OpenAPI contracts, versioning strategy, rate limiting, and gateway policy via Apigee.
* Frontend architecture — define the React.js application architecture — component and folder structure, state management, routing, API integration and error handling patterns, authentication flows, build tooling, and performance budgets.
* Security architecture — design OAuth2 and JWT\-based authentication and authorisation, IAM least\-privilege models, Secret Manager usage, and edge protection with Cloud Armor and global load balancing.
* Data architecture — model and optimise PostgreSQL and SQL Server schemas; design BigQuery warehousing, partitioning, clustering, and cost\-efficient analytical pipelines; define caching strategy with Redis and Memorystore.
* Cloud platform design — architect workloads across GKE, Cloud Run, Artifact Registry, Cloud Storage, Cloud Logging, and Vertex AI, balancing performance, reliability, and cloud spend.
* AI \& GenAI enablement — define reference architectures for Vertex AI and GenAI workloads, including model serving, RAG patterns, Agentic AI, and Agentic AI SDKs.
* Infrastructure as code — own the Terraform module design, environment promotion strategy, state management, and guardrails.



  





**Technical Skills — Must Have** 




**Languages \& paradigms:** 
 Expert\-level Python 3\.x including AsyncIO, concurrency, and parallel processing; strong command of object\-oriented and functional programming.
 



  





**Frameworks \& APIs:** 
 FastAPI REST framework; REST API design; OAuth2 and JWT authentication; GraphQL and gRPC exposure an advantage.
 



  





**Frontend:** 
 Strong hands\-on React.js — modern hooks, component composition, state management (Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or React Query), routing, form handling, and REST API integration; solid JavaScript and TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS3, responsive design, and frontend build tooling (Vite or Webpack). Able to define frontend architecture standards and review frontend code.
 



  





**Architecture:** 
 Microservices architecture, event\-driven and streaming systems, Kafka, and Google Cloud Pub/Sub and EventArc.
 



  





**Databases \& caching:** 
 PostgreSQL and SQL Server — schema design, query optimisation, indexing, and performance tuning; Redis and Memorystore for caching, sessions, and rate limiting; MySQL exposure.
 



  





**Data \& analytics:** 
 BigQuery for large\-scale warehousing, analytics, and reporting, including partitioning, clustering, and query cost optimisation.
 



  





**Google Cloud Platform:** 
 GKE, Cloud Run, Vertex AI and Gen AI services, Artifact Registry, Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL / MySQL), Memorystore, Cloud Armor, Global and External Load Balancing, Apigee, Cloud Logging, Cloud Storage buckets, Secret Manager, EventArc, Pub/Sub, and IAM.
 



  





**Containers \& orchestration:** 
 Docker and Kubernetes — image optimisation, autoscaling, resource limits, and health probes.
 



  





**Infrastructure as code:** 
 Terraform.
 



  





**CI/CD:** 
 Tekton and GitHub Actions, with Git\-based branching strategy and cloud deployment best practices.
 



  





**Testing:** 
 Pytest, test\-driven development, and automated quality gates in the pipeline.
 



  





**Observability:** 
 Dynatrace.
 



  





**Ways of working:** 
 Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and the full SDLC.
